35632.title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
35632.zh_title: 人工智能时代的纳税人行为：房产税上诉的实地实验
35632.authors: Justin E. Holz, Ricardo Perez-Truglia, Andrew Simon, Alejandro Zentner
35632.zh_abstract_excerpt: 应对税收制度通常需要纳税人可能缺乏的信息和判断力。尽管纳税人有时依赖人类专家，但人工智能可以以低得多的成本提供类似的帮助。然而，关于纳税人如何使用人工智能税务代理以及这些工具如何影响其行为，目前尚无因果证据。我们通过在房产税上诉背景下的实地实验填补了这一空白。我们招募了德克萨斯州达拉斯县的645户家庭作为样本。所有家庭都可以访问一个提供个性化信息、申请说明和支持证据的网站。
35632.abstract: Navigating the tax system often requires information and judgment that taxpayers may lack. Although taxpayers sometimes rely on human experts, AI could provide comparable assistance at substantially lower cost. Yet there is no causal evidence on how taxpayers use AI tax agents or how these tools affect their behavior. We fill this gap with a field experiment in the context of property tax appeals. We recruited a sample of 645 households in Dallas County, Texas. All households received access to a website providing personalized information, filing instructions, and supporting evidence for an appeal. Half were randomly assigned to a version of the website that also included an AI chatbot capable of answering questions and providing guidance tailored to their circumstances. Chatbot take-up was high: 78% initiated a conversation. Access to the chatbot increased the probability of filing an appeal without a human agent by 9.1 pp, from 41.4% to 50.5%. Evidence from clickstream data and conversation transcripts suggests that the chatbot helped households exercise judgment—that is, evaluate and act on the available information. The increase in appeal filing was smaller among less-advantaged households, providing suggestive evidence that the chatbot widened existing disparities. Our results demonstrate the potential of AI tax assistance while highlighting that who benefits depends not only on access, but also on how taxpayers use the technology.
35632.zh_abstract: 应对税收制度通常需要纳税人可能缺乏的信息和判断力。尽管纳税人有时依赖人类专家，但人工智能可以以低得多的成本提供类似的帮助。然而，关于纳税人如何使用人工智能税务代理以及这些工具如何影响其行为，目前尚无因果证据。我们通过在房产税上诉背景下的实地实验填补了这一空白。我们招募了德克萨斯州达拉斯县的645户家庭作为样本。所有家庭都可以访问一个提供个性化信息、申请说明和支持证据的网站。其中一半家庭被随机分配到一个包含人工智能聊天机器人的网站版本，该机器人能够回答问题并根据其具体情况提供指导。聊天机器人的使用率很高：78%的家庭发起了对话。使用聊天机器人使无人工代理提交上诉的概率增加了9.1个百分点，从41.4%提高到50.5%。来自点击流数据和对话记录的证据表明，聊天机器人帮助家庭行使判断力——即评估现有信息并采取行动。在弱势家庭中，上诉提交的增加幅度较小，这提供了提示性证据，表明聊天机器人扩大了现有的差距。我们的结果展示了人工智能税务援助的潜力，同时强调谁受益不仅取决于获取途径，还取决于纳税人如何使用该技术。

35631.title: Selection into Medicine
35631.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文考察了美国医学专业的选择如何影响医生的执业风格。我们利用医学院申请时的宏观经济状况作为申请者群体的外生冲击，发现其他声望较高领域的劳动力市场衰退会增加医学院的申请数量，并使入学群体的构成转向非医学预科背景的学生。引人注目的是，这些外部选择较差的群体在几十年后的执业方式有所不同。
35631.abstract: This paper examines how selection into medicine in the United States influences physician practice styles. We exploit macroeconomic conditions at the time of medical school application as an exogenous shock to the applicant pool and find that labor market downturns in other prestigious fields increase applications to medical school and shift the composition of matriculating cohorts toward students from non–pre-medical backgrounds. Strikingly, these low–outside-option cohorts practice medicine differently decades later. Conditional on experience, specialty, and outcome year, recession-cohort physicians bill Medicare more per beneficiary despite seeing healthier patients—particularly on discretionary, revenue-generating services—and sort into practice settings with higher-powered financial incentives. The additional spending does not produce detectable improvements in patient health. Taken together, our findings point to stronger financial motivation among those drawn into medicine when outside options are weak and suggest that medical school admissions screen imperfectly on the attributes that ultimately shape how physicians practice.
35631.zh_abstract: 本文考察了美国医学专业的选择如何影响医生的执业风格。我们利用医学院申请时的宏观经济状况作为申请者群体的外生冲击，发现其他声望较高领域的劳动力市场衰退会增加医学院的申请数量，并使入学群体的构成转向非医学预科背景的学生。引人注目的是，这些外部选择较差的群体在几十年后的执业方式有所不同。在控制经验、专业和结果年份的情况下，衰退期入学的医生尽管接诊的患者更健康，但每位受益人的医疗保险账单更高——尤其是在可自由支配的、创收的服务上——并且会选择财务激励更强的执业环境。额外的支出并未带来可检测的患者健康改善。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，当外部选择较弱时，被吸引进入医学领域的人具有更强的财务动机，并表明医学院招生在最终影响医生执业方式的属性上筛选并不完美。

35630.title: Tariffs, Investment, and the Missing Trade Collapse
35630.zh_title: 关税、投资与消失的贸易崩溃
35630.authors: Francesco Ferrante, Andrea Prestipino, Andrea Raffo, Michael E. Waugh
35630.zh_abstract_excerpt: 2025年美国关税税率升至大萧条以来未见的高位，然而进口却增加了。为了解释消失的贸易崩溃，我们构建了一个包含关税异质性、库存和投资冲击的开放经济新凯恩斯主义模型，其中投资冲击捕捉了人工智能驱动的繁荣。该模型匹配了进口、产出和通胀的未设定目标路径；我们用它来分解关税和投资繁荣的影响。如果没有投资繁荣，进口将下降10%，经济活动将收缩0.7%。关税的影响取决于哪些商品被征税：对消费品和中间品征税类似于供给冲击；对资本品征税类似于需求冲击。
35630.abstract: U.S. tariff rates in 2025 rose to levels not seen since the Great Depression, yet imports increased. To account for the missing trade collapse, we develop an open-economy New Keynesian model with tariff heterogeneity, inventories, and shocks to investment that capture the AI-driven boom. The model matches the untargeted paths of imports, output, and inflation; we use it to decompose the effects of tariffs and the investment boom. Absent the investment boom, imports would have fallen by 10 percent and activity would have contracted by 0.7 percent. The effects of tariffs depend on which goods are tariffed: tariffs on consumption and intermediates act like shocks to supply; tariffs on capital goods act like shocks to demand. The concentration of the 2025 tariff increases on consumption goods and the relative sparing of capital goods limited the damage to output while amplifying the inflationary impulse.

35629.title: Optimal Experimental Design and Estimation when Potential Outcomes are Bounded
35629.zh_title: 潜在结果有界时的最优实验设计与估计
35629.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我研究了当潜在结果已知有界（如二元结果）时，估计有限总体平均处理效应的随机实验的最优设计与分析。在所有分配机制和一类广泛的仿射估计量中，最坏情况均方误差（MSE）通过独立随机分配和对以支撑中点为中心的结果对去均值处理变量进行无截距的非传统回归来最小化。这与通常推荐的平衡完全随机化和均值差估计形成对比：当结果有界时，实现的处理份额中的随机性具有信息量。
35629.abstract: I study the optimal design and analysis of randomized experiments for estimating finite-population average treatment effects when potential outcomes are known to be bounded, as with binary outcomes. Among all assignment mechanisms and a broad class of affine estimators, worst-case mean-squared error (MSE) is minimized by independent random assignment and an unconventional regression of the support-midpoint-centered outcome on the recentered treatment, with no intercept. This contrasts with the usual prescription of balanced complete randomization and difference-in-means estimation: when outcomes are bounded, randomness in the realized treatment share is informative. The worst-case gain over full-sample complete randomization is asymptotically small, but gains can be first-order relative to other designs: complete within-pair randomization and pair-fixed-effect regression have twice the worst-case MSE. I then consider the general problem, allowing for any measurable estimator. Independent random assignment remains optimal, and the generally-nonlinear optimal estimator can meaningfully reduce worst-case MSE.
35629.zh_abstract: 我研究了当潜在结果已知有界（如二元结果）时，估计有限总体平均处理效应的随机实验的最优设计与分析。在所有分配机制和一类广泛的仿射估计量中，最坏情况均方误差（MSE）通过独立随机分配和对以支撑中点为中心的结果对去均值处理变量进行无截距的非传统回归来最小化。这与通常推荐的平衡完全随机化和均值差估计形成对比：当结果有界时，实现的处理份额中的随机性具有信息量。相对于全样本完全随机化，最坏情况下的增益渐近较小，但相对于其他设计可能是一阶的：完全配对随机化和配对固定效应回归的最坏情况MSE是前者的两倍。然后我考虑一般问题，允许任何可测估计量。独立随机分配仍然是最优的，而通常非线性的最优估计量可以显著降低最坏情况MSE。

35628.title: Do Minimum Wages Help Workers in Poor and Low-Income Families?
35628.zh_title: 最低工资是否帮助贫困和低收入家庭中的工人？
35628.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用收入与项目参与调查（该调查对低收入家庭进行了过度抽样）的数据，首次直接估计了最低工资对收入-需求比分布不同位置家庭中低工资工人的影响。我们发现，最低工资对贫困和低收入家庭中最初就业的低工资工人的就业、工时和收入产生了不利影响——而非有利影响。尽管我们没有发现梯度表明对最贫困的低工资工人有更不利的影响，但对贫困和低收入低工资工人的不利影响有助于解释为什么最低工资不能减少贫困。
35628.abstract: We provide the first direct estimates of the effects of minimum wages on low-wage workers in families at different points of the distribution of income-to-needs, using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation, which oversamples low-income families. We find adverse – rather than beneficial – effects of minimum wages on the employment, hours, and earnings of initially-employed low-wage workers in poor and low-income families. Although we do not find a gradient indicating more adverse effects on the poorest low-wage workers, the adverse effects for poor and low-income low-wage workers help explain why minimum wages do not reduce poverty.

35627.title: Provider Altruism and Medical Fraud: Evidence from an Audit Study of Malaria Treatment
35627.zh_title: 提供者利他主义与医疗欺诈：疟疾治疗审计研究的证据
35627.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提供了欺诈性诊断误报导致不必要医疗支出的证据，并表明这种行为与提供者的利润动机和较弱的社会偏好密切相关。我们使用伪装的标准患者（SP）在肯尼亚向私人提供者呈现相同的急性疟疾症状，作为真实的门诊患者，在受控条件下观察诊断和治疗决策，并通过外部验证疾病状态。由于SP被确认为疟疾阴性，任何报告的阳性诊断在构造上都是假阳性。提供者在81%的SP接触中订购了疟疾检测。
35627.abstract: We provide evidence of fraudulent diagnostic misreporting leading to spending on unnecessary medical care and show that it is strongly associated with provider profit motivation and weak prosocial preferences. Using incognito standardized patients (SP) presenting identical acute malaria symptoms as real walk-in clients to private providers in Kenya, we observe diagnostic and treatment decisions under controlled conditions with externally verified disease status. Because the SPs were confirmed to be malaria-negative, any reported positive diagnosis is a false positive by construction. Providers ordered malaria tests in 81% of the SP encounters. Conditional on administering a malaria test, providers report false positive results in 30% of encounters, substantially exceeding the approximately 3-5% false positive rates reported for the same malaria tests in diagnostic accuracy studies. This occurs despite near-perfect knowledge of appropriate diagnostic protocols. We link this behavior to provider preferences measured using a real-stakes, modified dictator game. While ordering a test is uncorrelated with preferences, the top 25% most profit-motivated providers report 16 percentage point (pp) more false positives and sell 20 pp more antimalarial drugs than more altruistic providers, conditional on ordering a malaria test. Misreporting is accompanied by selective concealment of diagnostic evidence from patients.
35627.zh_abstract: 我们提供了欺诈性诊断误报导致不必要医疗支出的证据，并表明这种行为与提供者的利润动机和较弱的社会偏好密切相关。我们使用伪装的标准患者（SP）在肯尼亚向私人提供者呈现相同的急性疟疾症状，作为真实的门诊患者，在受控条件下观察诊断和治疗决策，并通过外部验证疾病状态。由于SP被确认为疟疾阴性，任何报告的阳性诊断在构造上都是假阳性。提供者在81%的SP接触中订购了疟疾检测。在进行了疟疾检测的情况下，提供者在30%的接触中报告了假阳性结果，大大超过了同一疟疾检测在诊断准确性研究中报告的约3-5%的假阳性率。尽管提供者对适当的诊断方案有近乎完美的了解，这种情况仍然发生。我们将这种行为与使用真实赌注的改良独裁者游戏测量的提供者偏好联系起来。虽然订购检测与偏好无关，但最受利润驱动的25%的提供者报告假阳性的比例比更利他的提供者高16个百分点，并且在订购疟疾检测后多销售20个百分点的抗疟药物。误报伴随着选择性隐瞒患者的诊断证据。

35626.title: Outside Options and Labor Supply: Evidence from the Gig Economy
35626.zh_title: 外部选择与劳动力供给：来自零工经济的证据
35626.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用优步司机中的随机薪酬实验，并结合进入竞争对手的自然实验，来考察外部选择如何塑造企业对劳动力的供给。当工作时间灵活时，企业特定的劳动力供给弹性包含一个市场工时成分和一个企业替代成分。进入一个单一竞争平台几乎使司机的企业特定弹性翻倍，并将隐含的买方垄断加价折扣从68%降至约50%。同样的实验识别出性别差异：女性对市场的弹性约为男性的两倍，但对雇主的弹性却并不低于男性。
35626.abstract: We use randomized pay experiments among Uber drivers, paired with a natural experiment in access to a competitor, to examine how outside options shape labor supply to the firm. When hours are flexible, the firm-specific labor supply elasticity combines a market-hours component and a firm-substitution component. Access to a single competing platform nearly doubles drivers’ firm-specific elasticity and cuts the implied monopsony markdown from 68% to about 50%. The same experiments identify sex differences: women are about twice as elastic to the market as men, yet no less elastic to their employer.

35625.title: When Public Signals Backfire: Strategic Disclosure and Information Crowd-Out
35625.zh_title: 当公共信号适得其反：策略性披露与信息挤出
35625.authors: Marty Haoyuan Chen, Ginger Zhe Jin
35625.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究当部分天真的接收者观察到与发送者私人信息相关的公共信号时的自愿披露。我们开发了一个框架，其中公共信号改变了接收者如何解读沉默，并推导出一个嵌套经典“拆解”结果的闭式披露阈值。一个改变相关性的实验室实验证实了我们的预测：随着信号变得更加有利，披露减少，并且接收者在未披露时的猜测向其靠拢。公共信号可以挤出披露，使接收者比没有该信号时信息更少。这种信息损失在中等相关性时达到峰值，此时信号改变了信念，但仍过于嘈杂而无法替代披露。
35625.abstract: We study voluntary disclosure when partially naive receivers observe a public signal correlated with the sender’s private information. We develop a framework in which the public signal changes how receivers interpret silence, and derive a closed-form disclosure threshold nesting classical unraveling. A laboratory experiment varying the correlation confirms our predictions: disclosure decreases as the signal becomes more favorable, and receiver guesses upon nondisclosure rise toward it. The public signal can crowd out disclosure, leaving receivers less informed than without it. This informational loss peaks at intermediate correlation, where the signal shifts beliefs yet remains too noisy to substitute for disclosure.

35624.title: Sticky Wage Norms and the Real Wage Cost of Unexpected Inflation
35624.zh_title: 粘性工资规范与意外通胀的实际工资成本
35624.authors: Erik Hurst, Christina Patterson, Nela Thomas Richardson, Ye Liv Wang
35624.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用覆盖美国工人中具有全国代表性的大型行政工资单数据样本，研究在近期通胀期间工资是如何调整的。大多数公司对其大多数工人采用单一的年度名义工资增长模式，而这些公司层面的规范在近期意外通胀期间变化甚微。因此，对于留在原公司的很大一部分工人来说，名义工资未能跟上物价上涨。在2021年至2024年这四年间持续受雇于同一家公司的工人中，有43%经历了实际工资下降，其中落后者的平均损失约为9%。
35624.abstract: We use a sample of administrative payroll data covering a large and nationally representative share of U.S. workers to study how wages adjusted during the recent inflation period. Most firms apply a single modal annual nominal wage increase to the majority of their workers, and these firm-level norms changed little during the recent period of unexpected inflation. As a result, nominal wages did not keep pace with prices for a large share of workers who stayed at their firms. Forty-three percent of workers continuously employed at the same firm over the four years spanning 2021–2024 experienced a real wage decline, with a mean loss of roughly nine percent among those who fell behind. Workers could escape sticky wage norms by changing employers — job-changers’ wages rose nearly one-for-one with inflation — but switching was too infrequent to matter for most. Even accounting for job-changers, 37 percent of all workers saw real wages decline over the 4-year period. Indexing firms’ modal raises one-for-one to inflation would have closed roughly 40 percent of the resulting shortfall relative to prepandemic trend. Drawing on cross-country evidence from Belgium, whose wages are automatically indexed to inflation, we show that incomplete wage indexation, rather than inflation itself, helps explain the persistence of depressed consumer sentiment during the 2021–2024 period.
35624.zh_abstract: 我们使用覆盖美国工人中具有全国代表性的大型行政工资单数据样本，研究在近期通胀期间工资是如何调整的。大多数公司对其大多数工人采用单一的年度名义工资增长模式，而这些公司层面的规范在近期意外通胀期间变化甚微。因此，对于留在原公司的很大一部分工人来说，名义工资未能跟上物价上涨。在2021年至2024年这四年间持续受雇于同一家公司的工人中，有43%经历了实际工资下降，其中落后者的平均损失约为9%。工人可以通过更换雇主来逃避粘性工资规范——换工作者的工资几乎与通胀率一比一上涨——但换工作的频率太低，对大多数人来说无关紧要。即使考虑到换工作者，仍有37%的所有工人在四年期间实际工资下降。将公司的模式化加薪与通胀率进行一比一的指数化，将弥补与疫情前趋势相比约40%的缺口。借鉴比利时的跨国证据（其工资自动与通胀挂钩），我们表明，不完全的工资指数化，而非通胀本身，有助于解释2021-2024年期间消费者情绪持续低迷的现象。

35623.title: Race and Redistricting in Local Governments
35623.zh_title: 地方政府中的种族与选区划分
35623.authors: Carlos Fernando Avenancio-León, Daniel B. Jones, Ying Shi
35623.zh_abstract_excerpt: 选举地图将居住地理转化为政治代表，然而全国数千个地方政府的选举地图从未被系统性地测量过。我们利用全国选民档案和人口普查数据，重建了18,521个选区的3,712个市议会和县委员会地图。已颁布的地图过度代表了白人选民，而代表性不足黑人和西班牙裔选民，这些差距预测了公职人员的种族构成。我们将这些地图与满足常见选区划分约束的模拟、种族盲地图进行对比。模拟地图再现了这种差异的大部分，表明在划定任何边界之前，地理就已经使代表性发生偏差。
35623.abstract: Electoral maps translate residential geography into political representation, yet they have never been systematically measured for thousands of local governments across the country. We reconstruct 3,712 city council and county commission maps across 18,521 districts using nationwide voter-file and Census data. Enacted maps overrepresent White voters and underrepresent Black and Hispanic voters, with gaps predicting the racial composition of officeholders. We juxtapose these with simulated, race-blind maps satisfying common districting constraints. Simulated maps reproduce much of this disparity, showing that geography skews representation before any boundary-drawing. Enacted maps substantially improve on the race-blind baseline only in jurisdictions subject to oversight from the Voting Rights Act or districting litigation. As courts curtail race-conscious districting, local governments may revert to a baseline that is formally neutral but substantively unequal.
35623.zh_abstract: 选举地图将居住地理转化为政治代表，然而全国数千个地方政府的选举地图从未被系统性地测量过。我们利用全国选民档案和人口普查数据，重建了18,521个选区的3,712个市议会和县委员会地图。已颁布的地图过度代表了白人选民，而代表性不足黑人和西班牙裔选民，这些差距预测了公职人员的种族构成。我们将这些地图与满足常见选区划分约束的模拟、种族盲地图进行对比。模拟地图再现了这种差异的大部分，表明在划定任何边界之前，地理就已经使代表性发生偏差。只有在受《投票权法》或选区划分诉讼监督的司法管辖区，已颁布的地图才在种族盲基线上有显著改善。随着法院限制种族意识选区划分，地方政府可能会回归到形式上中立但实质上不平等的基线。

35622.title: Virtual Tutoring with Computer-Assisted Learning: An Experiment in Take-Up and Learning
35622.zh_title: 计算机辅助学习的虚拟辅导：参与度与学习效果的实验
35622.authors: Philip Oreopoulos, Ruochong Dong, Nina Low
35622.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们探讨了一个在线课后辅导项目的效果，该项目补充了教师提供的计算机辅助学习练习。其目的是为在学校进行在线可汗学院练习有困难的学生，提供每周约一小时的低成本、一对一的虚拟监督。在多伦多地区教育局进行的一项为期两年的随机试验中，教师识别出有困难的4-8年级学生，然后随机向其家长提供额外的在线辅导以支持他们在家的练习。主要障碍是参与度。第一年，只有45%的被分配学生参加了第一次辅导。
35622.abstract: We explore the efficacy of an online after-school tutoring program that complements teacher-provided computer-assisted learning practice. The aim is to scaffold students struggling with online Khan Academy practice at school with low-cost, one-on-one virtual supervision for about an hour a week at home. In a two-year randomized trial with the Toronto District School Board, teachers identified struggling Grade 4–8 students, whose parents were then randomly offered additional online tutoring to support their practice at home. The main obstacle was participation. Only 45% of assigned students reached a first session in Year 1. After we reframed the invitation and simplified enrollment, initial take-up in Year 2 rose to 83%, though weekly attendance remained below half—not because students dropped out, but because they attended intermittently. On average, the offer raised Khan Academy practice by about 10 minutes per week. This translated to an average gain in math assessment scores of 0.06 SD, with a confidence interval too wide to rule out null or medium-sized gains (ITT 0.055 SD; 95% CI [−0.09, 0.20]). We find a marginally significant gain in math report-card marks (about 0.08 SD; 95% CI [−0.01, 0.17]) and improvements in math satisfaction and enjoyment, with effects larger in Year 2 than in Year 1, consistent with the higher take-up that year. We therefore conclude that the program holds promise, but more is needed to ensure students actually engage with tutors on a regular basis.

35621.title: Making AI Tutoring Productive: Evidence from a Mastery-Based Math Practice Experiment
35621.zh_title: 让AI辅导富有成效：基于精熟学习的数学练习实验证据
35621.authors: Philip Oreopoulos, Michael Liut, Alp Sungu, Nina Low
35621.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以使辅导更具可扩展性，但前提是学生利用它们来推理错误，而不是逃避努力。我们在汉密尔顿县学校的随机现场实验中研究了这个问题，涉及超过6,000名中学生，使用了基于研究的计算机辅助学习（CAL）平台NUMI。学生被随机分配到AI与仅CAL支持、精熟与非精熟进度，以及两个数学主题之一。一周后，他们完成了一项延迟评估，涵盖练习过和未练习的材料。AI学生进度更慢，尝试的问题更少，但在达到尝试时回答更准确。
35621.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can make tutoring more scalable, but only if students use them to reason through mistakes rather than avoid effort. We study this question in a randomized field experiment with more than 6, 000 middle-school students in Hamilton County Schools using NUMI, a research-based computer-assisted learning (CAL) platform. Students were randomized to AI versus CAL-only support, mastery versus non-mastery progression, and one of two math topics. One week later, they completed a delayed assessment covering practiced and unpracticed material. AI students progressed more slowly and attempted fewer questions, but answered more accurately conditional on reaching an attempt. The clearest mechanism appeared after mistakes: AI improved next-attempt correctness and reduced attempts needed to return to a correct answer, while increasing time spent on each question receiving structured support. Mastery increased three-correct-in-a-row attainment but did not by itself improve delayed learning. The most encouraging delayed-test evidence appears when AI is embedded in the mastery workflow, with marginally significant gains concentrated on practiced Exercise 1 material. The results suggest that LLM tutoring can add value over standard CAL, but its value depends on structure that turns mistakes into productive learning moments.
35621.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以使辅导更具可扩展性，但前提是学生利用它们来推理错误，而不是逃避努力。我们在汉密尔顿县学校的随机现场实验中研究了这个问题，涉及超过6,000名中学生，使用了基于研究的计算机辅助学习（CAL）平台NUMI。学生被随机分配到AI与仅CAL支持、精熟与非精熟进度，以及两个数学主题之一。一周后，他们完成了一项延迟评估，涵盖练习过和未练习的材料。AI学生进度更慢，尝试的问题更少，但在达到尝试时回答更准确。最清晰的机制出现在错误之后：AI提高了下一次尝试的正确率，并减少了恢复到正确答案所需的尝试次数，同时增加了在每次接受结构化支持的问题上花费的时间。精熟学习提高了连续三次正确的达成率，但本身并未改善延迟学习。最令人鼓舞的延迟测试证据出现在AI嵌入精熟学习流程中时，边际显著收益集中在练习过的练习1材料上。结果表明，LLM辅导可以在标准CAL之上增加价值，但其价值取决于将错误转化为有效学习时刻的结构。

35619.title: Institutional Variation in Child Maltreatment Reporting
35619.zh_title: 儿童虐待报告的制度性差异
35619.authors: E. Jason Baron, Micah Y. Baum, Joseph J. Doyle Jr., Maria D. Fitzpatrick, Brian Jacob, Joseph P. Ryan
35619.zh_abstract_excerpt: 儿童福利系统的介入程度在不同地区差异巨大。虽然部分差异可能反映了潜在的虐待风险差异，但也可能源于对类似情况的不同制度性回应。为厘清这些解释，我们研究了2017–2024年与儿童保护服务报告相关联的密歇根州公立学校数据。学校层面的报告率从几乎为零到超过一半的学生在幼儿园至五年级期间被报告不等。我们使用增值法估计了学校特定的报告倾向，并记录了在考虑学生风险差异后报告行为的显著差异。利用学生流动者样本，我们证明这些估计具有预测无偏性。
35619.abstract: Involvement with the child welfare system varies dramatically across places. While some of this variation may reflect differences in underlying maltreatment risk, it may also result from differences in institutional responses to similar circumstances. To disentangle these explanations, we study Michigan public school data linked to Child Protective Services reports from 2017–2024. School-level reporting rates range from virtually none to more than half of students reported between kindergarten and fifth grade. We estimate school-specific reporting tendencies using value-added methods and document substantial variation in reporting behavior after accounting for differences in student risk. Using student movers, we show that these estimates are forecast-unbiased. Our estimates imply that school-specific reporting practices account for roughly 40 percent of the variation in reporting rates across schools. We then estimate a structural model that decomposes reporting practices into diagnostic skill and preferences. Differences in skill explain more than twice as much variation as differences in preferences, and higher-reporting schools tend to be more skilled at identifying high-risk cases. Counterfactual simulations imply that improving detection skill would yield significant welfare gains, while recent policy proposals aimed at reducing or equalizing reporting rates generally lower welfare by increasing the number of high-risk cases that go unreported.

35618.title: The Global Transition – The Impact of Demographics and AI on Economic Power
35618.zh_title: 全球转型——人口结构与人工智能对经济实力的影响
35618.authors: Seth G. Benzell, Laurence J. Kotlikoff, Victor Yifan Ye
35618.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本研究运用一个多区域、动态生命周期、一般均衡模型来评估本世纪人口结构对全球发展的影响。我们模型的17个区域涵盖150多个国家，占世界人口的99%。产出由三个劳动技能组和国际流动资本生产，每个国家每年决定是否采用其前沿自动化技术。我们的模型具有区域特定的财政政策、全要素生产率增长和特殊死亡率。个体寿命为100年，先为儿童，再为工人，后为退休人员。工作和储蓄决策由CES偏好支配。寿命不确定，但除国家养老金外没有年金。
35618.abstract: This study deploys a multi-region, dynamic life-cycle, general equilibrium model to assess demography’s impact, through the course of this century, on global development. Our model’s 17 regions encompass more than 150 countries comprising 99% of the world’s population. Output is produced with three labor skill groups and internationally-mobile capital, with each country deciding annually whether to adopt its frontier automation technology. Our model features region-specific fiscal policy, TFP growth, and idiosyncratic mortality. Agents live for 100 years, first as children, then as workers, and then as retirees. Work and saving decisions are governed by CES preferences. Lifespan is uncertain, but there are no annuities apart from state pensions. Hence, bequests, while significant, are unintended. Our fertility, mortality, and net immigration rates are region- and age-specific and align fully with the UN’s projections. To illustrate demographics’ power to impact the global transition, we simulate our model under the UN’s markedly different demographic projections for 2017 and 2024. The 2024 forecast is particularly pessimistic about China’s fertility prospects. Both projections produce very substantial global aging, a major global capital glut producing very low long-run real capital returns. The latest forecast entails 10% lower global GDP in 2100 and far higher payroll tax rates to fund old-age benefits. Most important, it entails a major change in the course of economic hegemony with China’s 2100 global GDP share falling from 25.6% to 14.9% and the US share rising from 11.2% to 14.4%. Our results are sensitive. Should the US eliminate all future immigration, its 14.4% global 2100 GDP share would drop to 9.2%. And were global fertility to follow the UN’s low variant, 2100 world output would be one third, not one tenth lower. The level and division of global output is also highly sensitive to the speed at which AI expands frontier technologies. Accelerated AU/AI – 4x faster-than-recent growth in capital’s share through 2050 – or Transformative AU/AI – 10x faster capital-share growth – reinforce demographic forces, ensuring long-run US economic hegemony. Indeed, Transformative AI combined with 2024 demographics implies US and Chinese 2100 global GDP shares of 25.3% and 16.9%, respectively. And not withstanding its considerable technological catch up, the US retains, based on our calibration, a technological edge over China throughout the century.
35618.zh_abstract: 本研究运用一个多区域、动态生命周期、一般均衡模型来评估本世纪人口结构对全球发展的影响。我们模型的17个区域涵盖150多个国家，占世界人口的99%。产出由三个劳动技能组和国际流动资本生产，每个国家每年决定是否采用其前沿自动化技术。我们的模型具有区域特定的财政政策、全要素生产率增长和特殊死亡率。个体寿命为100年，先为儿童，再为工人，后为退休人员。工作和储蓄决策由CES偏好支配。寿命不确定，但除国家养老金外没有年金。因此，遗赠虽然可观，却是非故意的。我们的生育率、死亡率和净移民率是区域和年龄特定的，并与联合国的预测完全一致。为说明人口结构影响全球转型的力量，我们在联合国2017年和2024年显著不同的人口预测下模拟了我们的模型。2024年的预测对中国生育前景尤为悲观。两种预测都产生了非常显著的全球老龄化，以及导致长期实际资本回报率极低的重大全球资本过剩。最新预测意味着2100年全球GDP低10%，且为资助老年福利所需的工资税率远高于以往。最重要的是，它意味着经济霸权进程的重大变化，中国2100年全球GDP份额从25.6%降至14.9%，美国份额从11.2%升至14.4%。我们的结果具有敏感性。如果美国消除所有未来移民，其2100年14.4%的全球GDP份额将降至9.2%。而如果全球生育率遵循联合国的低变体，2100年世界产出将降低三分之一而非十分之一。全球产出的水平和分配也对AI扩展前沿技术的速度高度敏感。加速AI/AI——到2050年资本份额增长比近期快4倍——或变革性AI/AI——资本份额增长快10倍——将强化人口力量，确保美国长期经济霸权。事实上，变革性AI与2024年人口结构相结合意味着美国和中国的2100年全球GDP份额分别为25.3%和16.9%。而且，尽管有相当大的技术追赶，根据我们的校准，美国在整个世纪中对中国保持技术优势。

35617.title: The Cov-lite Liquidity Advantage, Regulatory Pressures, and the Evolution of the Leveraged Loan Market
35617.zh_title: 宽松契约流动性优势、监管压力与杠杆贷款市场的演变
35617.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在全球金融危机之后，监管机构使银行更难保留杠杆贷款敞口。我们推测，他们的行动增加了无维护契约贷款（宽松契约贷款）在杠杆贷款发行中的份额，因为此类贷款更容易出售。我们发现，危机后，对于面临更严格监管、未直接通过压力测试或对严重不利压力测试情景表现出更大脆弱性的银行，宽松契约贷款发行的份额增加更多。我们表明，正如理论预期，宽松契约贷款具有流动性优势，这降低了其信用利差，且对私营企业而言更高。
35617.abstract: Following the global financial crisis (GFC), regulators made it harder for banks to retain leveraged loan exposure. We conjecture their actions increased the share of leveraged loan issuances with no maintenance covenants (cov-lite loans) because such loans are easier to sell. We find that, post-GFC, the share of cov-lite loan issuance increased more for banks facing stricter regulation, failing to pass a stress test outright, or exhibiting greater vulnerability to the severely adverse stress test scenario. We show that, as expected from theory, cov-lite loans have a liquidity advantage that lowers their credit spread and is higher for private firms.

35616.title: Do Children Derail Women from the CEO Track?
35616.zh_title: 孩子会使女性偏离CEO轨道吗？
35616.zh_abstract_excerpt: 成为CEO的性别差异显著，而成为CEO的女性，尤其是大公司的CEO，更不可能有孩子或结婚。我们利用覆盖哥斯达黎加所有税务注册公司的纵向行政数据，并与提供生育和结婚时间的全民民事登记记录相匹配，研究了孩子和婚姻对成为CEO的影响。我们发现，首次生育后，女性成为CEO的概率持续下降，但男性没有类似的下降，且有一些证据表明男性CEO成就上升。婚姻表现出不同但仍分化的模式：它与男性后续CEO成就提高相关，但对女性几乎没有变化。
35616.abstract: Gender disparities in becoming a CEO are pronounced, and women who become CEOs, especially of large firms, are less likely to have children or be married. We find that first childbirth is followed by a persistent decline in women’s probability of becoming a CEO, but no comparable decline for men and some evidence that CEO attainment rises. Marriage displays a different but still divergent pattern: it is associated with higher subsequent CEO attainment for men, but little change for women. Changes around childbirth account for a substantial share of the overall gender difference in CEO rates. Finally, we find evidence consistent with household specialization as a potential mechanism. Around marriage and first childbirth, women’s formal employment, earnings, and share of household earnings decline, while men become more central to household earnings as their partners reduce formal employment.

35615.title: Identifying Policy Causal Effects from Rule Changes
35615.zh_title: 从规则变化中识别政策因果效应

35615.abstract: Recent applied work has used interacted local projections to study how the propagation of macroeconomic shocks changes with the policy regime. We characterize the estimand of such strategies and relate it to the policy shock literature. Our main result is a set of conditions on the regressors and underlying data-generating process under which those two approaches are equivalent in the nature of their estimand, with both identifying slices of the same space of policy dynamic causal effects. Since policy is inherently high-dimensional, however, the two approaches generically recover different slices of that space. For example, for monetary policy, standard shocks tend to deliver the effects of transitory policy rate changes, while looking across policy regimes instead isolates gradual, more forward guidance-like policy treatments.

35614.title: Declining Occupations and Career Outcomes in the United States
35614.zh_title: 美国衰退职业与职业结果
35614.authors: Erling Barth, Maria Forthun Hoen, Sari Pekkala Kerr, William R. Kerr
35614.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了初始就业于随后衰退的职业所带来的长期职业后果。将2000年十年一次的人口普查与美国行政就业和收入记录（截至2020年）相关联，我们追踪了超过240万名工人。在收缩至少25%的职业中就业，尽管工作季度数略多，但与累计收入降低约5%相关。收入差异与瑞典和挪威的证据高度吻合，尽管就业调整有所不同。职业流动性显著但不完全，而子女后来的职业去向与户主2000年职业增长类别的关联性要弱得多。

Linking the 2000 Decennial Census to US administrative employment and earnings records through 2020, we follow more than 2.4 million workers. The earnings differential closely matches evidence from Sweden and Norway, although employment adjustment differs. Occupational mobility is substantial but incomplete, while children’s later occupational destinations are much less tied to their household heads’ 2000 occupational-growth categories.

35613.title: Short-Run Impacts of SNAP Restriction Waivers on Beverage Purchases
35613.zh_title: SNAP限制豁免对饮料购买的短期影响
35613.authors: David E. Frisvold, Felipe Lozano Rojas
35613.zh_abstract_excerpt: 2026年，十个州首次在项目历史上实施了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）食品限制豁免，以限制使用SNAP资金购买含糖饮料。我们使用一个新的家庭饮料购买面板数据集来估计这些豁免的短期影响。对于平均SNAP家庭，这些豁免使苏打水购买量减少13%，且在实施后长达两个月内效果持续。对于边际内SNAP家庭，这些豁免使苏打水购买量减少18.5%。
35613.abstract: Ten states implemented Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Food Restriction Waivers to restrict purchases of sugary beverages with SNAP funds for the first time in program history in 2026. We estimate the short-run impact of these waivers using a new panel dataset of household beverage purchases. For the average SNAP household, these waivers decrease soda purchases by 13 percent with persistent effects for up to two months after implementation. For inframarginal SNAP households, these waivers decrease soda purchases by 18.5 percent. These findings are inconsistent with the predictions of traditional demand theory and suggest that behavioral models incorporating mental accounting and labeling better characterize consumer responses to SNAP purchase restrictions.

35612.title: Beliefs about Government Debt Valuation and Sustainability
35612.zh_title: 关于政府债务估值与可持续性的信念
35612.zh_abstract_excerpt: 最终是什么支撑了美国政府债务的市场价值？我们衡量估值框架：支撑债务价值的感知渠道。我们调查了债券投资者、登记选民以及经济学或金融学研究生学位持有者，要求他们将债务价值分配到六个来源，这些来源源自开放式回答和文献。全球安全资产需求和永久性展期在每个群体中合计占感知价值的近一半，因此债务价值在很大程度上依赖于投资者吸收而非政府资源。未来基本盈余，即教科书式的债务支撑，即使在受过研究生培训的群体中也仅获得约16%的权重；
35612.abstract: What ultimately supports the market value of U.S. government debt? We measure valuation frameworks: the perceived channels that back debt value. We survey bond investors, registered voters, and economics or finance graduate-degree holders, asking them to allocate debt value across six sources derived from open-ended answers and the literature. Global safe-asset demand and permanent rollover together account for almost half of perceived value in every group, so debt value heavily relies on investor absorption rather than on government resources. Future primary surpluses, the textbook debt backing, receive about 16% even among the graduate-trained; roughly one-third say they provide little or no support. Allocations concentrate within respondents but disperse across them, forming belief archetypes that vary little with fiscal knowledge. A model shows why belief elicitation matters: identical debt quantities and price schedules can conceal differences in saleable public backing and stress-resilient demand, and therefore in debt sustainability. Concern about debt sustainability is widespread, and all three groups put the ten-year crisis odds near 50%. However, among respondents expressing concern, 90% of voters report that it is not decisive in their voting decisions, and 72% of investors report no concrete portfolio change.

35611.title: Social Clubs and Political Office
35611.zh_title: 社交俱乐部与政治职位
35611.authors: Julien Labonne, Pablo Querubín, Martín Rossi, Sebastian M. Saiegh, Ivan San Miguel, Shanker Satyanath
35611.zh_abstract_excerpt: 即使在形式上包容的政治体系中，精英也维持着不成比例的政治权力，然而他们协调和再生产这种优势的制度仍鲜为人知。我们研究了布宜诺斯艾利斯赛马俱乐部——阿根廷最著名的精英社交俱乐部——的会员资格，利用家庭入会的交错变化。使用双重差分技术，我们发现赛马俱乐部会员资格将使担任立法职务的概率提高约四个百分点——超过对照组均值的两倍。
35611.abstract: Elites maintain disproportionate political power even in formally inclusive political systems, yet the institutions through which they coordinate and reproduce this advantage remain poorly understood. We study membership in the Buenos Aires Jockey Club—Argentina's most prominent elite social club—exploiting staggered variation in family entry. Using difference-in-differences techniques, we find that Jockey Club membership increased the probability of holding legislative office by approximately four percentage points—more than twice the control-group mean. Consistent with a network-based mechanism, membership also increased families' centrality in elite marriage networks—a resource that can facilitate political success through access to party nominations and voter mobilization. This electoral advantage declines substantially after the 1912 Sáenz Peña democratizing reforms, suggesting that the political returns to club membership are conditional on institutional contexts that make elite network connections valuable. Our findings shed light on how elite social institutions reproduce political inequality where personal connections are essential for accessing political office.

35610.title: The Limits of Government Outsourcing: Property Tax Re-Assessments in India
35610.zh_title: 政府外包的局限：印度的财产税重新评估
35610.authors: Esther Duflo, Rema Hanna, Benjamin A. Olken, Shreya Tandon
35610.zh_abstract_excerpt: 外包理论通常假定私营企业是商品和服务的更高效生产者，但缔约摩擦意味着企业不会内化政府的目标函数。但也许，对于某些任务，政府实际上可能更具生产效率？我们通过印度金奈的一项实验来研究这个问题，政府随机选择社区，由政府签约的私营企业而非政府税务检查员来确定财产税评估。我们表明，政府税务检查员的检查带来的税收收入增长几乎是私营企业的两倍。根据我们聘请的第三方测量员进行的独立评估比较，它们也更准确。与政府缔约的困难使许多有能力的公司不愿投标。
35610.abstract: Theories of outsourcing often presume that private firms are more efficient producers of goods and services, but that contracting frictions mean that firms do not internalize the government's objective function. But perhaps, for some tasks, the government can actually be more productively efficient? We study this question through an experiment in Chennai, India, where the government randomly selected neighborhoods to have property tax assessments determined by private firms contracted by the government, rather than government tax inspectors. We show that inspections by government tax inspectors yielded almost double the increase in tax revenue as those done by private firms. They were also more accurate, as judged by comparing new assessments to independent assessments done by third-party surveyors we hired. Difficulties contracting with the government discouraged many competent firms from bidding. Perhaps as a result, government inspectors had higher skills and put in more effort than the workers at the private firms. Importantly, the government inspectors also had more authority to enter properties, which may be hard to transfer even to higher quality firms. The results suggest that the limits to government outsourcing may go beyond multitasking issues.

35609.title: Exchange Rates, Structural Change, and Productivity Growth
35609.zh_title: 汇率、结构变化与生产率增长
35609.authors: Paul Bergin, Woo Jin Choi, Ju H. Pyun
35609.zh_abstract_excerpt: 宏观经济学倾向于将汇率变动视为暂时性的。然而，持续的汇率重估和相关的资本流动可能对结构变化和生产率增长产生长期影响。我们提供了经验证据，表明储备积累和货币低估政策对制造业生产率以及制造业份额、产品种类和生产链的国内导向产生了显著影响。我们开发了一个具有两个部门、企业动态和贸易滞后的动态两国模型，以展示汇率政策重新定向全球供应链和产业结构的新机制。该模型确定了此类政策提高本国生产率和福利的条件。
35609.abstract: Macroeconomics tends to view exchange rate movements as transitory. However, persistent exchange rate realignments and the associated capital flows can have long-run implications for structural change and productivity growth. We provide empirical evidence that policies of reserve accumulation and currency undervaluation have had significant effects on manufacturing productivity, as well as on manufacturing share, product varieties, and domestic orientation of production chains. We develop a dynamic two-country model with two sectors, firm dynamics, and trade hysteresis to demonstrate a novel mechanism by which exchange rate policy reorients global supply chains and industrial structure. The model identifies conditions under which such a policy raises productivity and welfare in the home country. It also identifies conditions under which the policy leads to either permanent or reversible deindustrialization in a trading partner. Findings have implications for the long-run relationship between China and the U.S.
35609.zh_abstract: 宏观经济学倾向于将汇率变动视为暂时性的。然而，持续的汇率重估和相关的资本流动可能对结构变化和生产率增长产生长期影响。我们提供了经验证据，表明储备积累和货币低估政策对制造业生产率以及制造业份额、产品种类和生产链的国内导向产生了显著影响。我们开发了一个具有两个部门、企业动态和贸易滞后的动态两国模型，以展示汇率政策重新定向全球供应链和产业结构的新机制。该模型确定了此类政策提高本国生产率和福利的条件。它还确定了该政策导致贸易伙伴永久性或可逆去工业化的条件。研究结果对中美之间的长期关系具有启示意义。

35608.title: Monopsony Makes it Big
35608.authors: Sydnee Caldwell, Arindrajit Dube, Suresh Naidu
35608.zh_abstract_excerpt: 近年来，关于劳动力市场不完全竞争的文献迅速扩展。本文为该领域提供了一份指南，重点关注企业特定（“剩余”）劳动力供给弹性作为企业劳动力市场势力的定义。我们提出了一个一般性框架，展示该弹性如何涵盖买方垄断势力的三个被广泛研究的来源：搜索摩擦、偏好异质性和雇主集中度。我们总结了劳动力供给弹性的实证估计，并强调了可能存在的异质性来源。
35608.abstract: The literature on imperfect competition in labor markets has expanded rapidly in recent years. This article provides a guide to the field, focusing on the firm-specific ("residual") labor supply elasticity as the definition of a firm's labor market power. We present a general framework showing how this elasticity nests the three widely studied sources of monopsony power: search frictions, preference heterogeneity, and employer concentration. We summarize the empirical estimates of the elasticity of labor supply, highlighting sources of possible heterogeneity. We emphasize that it is difficult to infer elasticities from markdowns (and vice versa) due to the diversity of firm wage-setting practices, illustrating this point using the interaction between monopsony and efficiency wages. We discuss how policy issues in antitrust, labor market regulation, immigration, and macroeconomics interact with monopsony and conclude by listing several areas for future research.

35607.title: Credit Card Banking
35607.authors: Itamar Drechsler, Hyeyoon Jung, Weiyu Peng, Dominik Supera, Guanyu Zhou
35607.zh_abstract_excerpt: 信用卡利率目前平均为22%，比短期利率高出18个百分点。这一利差远超任何其他贷款或债券，然而近一半的家庭是信用卡借款人。为什么信用卡利率如此之高？为了理解这一点以及信用卡银行业的经济学，我们使用监管账户级数据分析了5.5亿个月度账户的终身现金流，这些账户代表了美国信用卡市场的90%。虽然核销率相对较高，平均约为6%，但这只能解释信用卡利差的一小部分。奖励支付和非利息支出被交换费和非利息收入所抵消。
35607.abstract: Credit card interest rates currently average 22%, an 18% spread over the short rate. This spread far exceeds that on any other loan or bond, yet nearly half of households are credit card borrowers. Why are credit card rates so high? To understand this, and the economics of credit card banking, we use regulatory account-level data to analyze the lifetime cash flows of 550 million monthly accounts, representing 90% of the US credit card market. While charge-off rates are comparatively high, averaging around 6%, they explain only a fraction of cards' spread. Reward payments and non-interest expenses are more than offset by interchange and non-interest income. Operating expenses, particularly marketing, are very large, and are used to generate pricing power. Yet, after deducting them, card lending still earns a 6.8% return on assets (ROA), more than four times the banking sector's ROA. Using the cross section of accounts, we estimate that credit card rates price in a 4.3% default risk premium, similar to high-yield bonds. Accounting for this, card lending earns an alpha of around 1.5% relative to the aggregate bank sector.

35606.title: Supplemental Medicare Insurance Coverage for Older Adults with Probable Dementia
35606.zh_title: 可能患有痴呆症的老年人的补充医疗保险覆盖情况
35606.authors: Melissa McInerney, Lorena Moreno, Jennifer M. Mellor
35606.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在本文中，我们比较了可能患有痴呆症的人群（PWPD）和匹配的对照组在发病前后补充医疗保险的覆盖情况。这是一项使用倾向评分权重和2000-2016年健康与退休研究（HRS）数据进行的回顾性二次数据分析。样本包括3,001名65岁及以上参加Medicare的可能患有痴呆症的成年人，以及14,055名对照组。可能痴呆症通过Langa-Weir方法和代理访谈的访谈者评估来评估。
35606.abstract: In this paper, we compare supplemental Medicare insurance coverage among people with probable dementia (PWPD) and matched controls, before and after onset. This retrospective secondary data analysis of insurance coverage changes using propensity score weights and the 2000-2016 Health and Retirement Study (HRS). The sample consists of 3,001 Medicare-enrolled adults age 65 and older with PWPD, and 14,055 controls. Probable dementia is assessed with the Langa-Weir approach and interviewer assessments for proxy interviews. Four years before onset, PWPD become more likely to have Medicare without supplemental coverage (2.97 percentage points; p=0.0016) than matched controls. This reflects the net effect of PWPD being less likely to have Medicare Advantage or traditional Medicare with supplemental coverage, and more likely to have Medicaid. Two years before onset, PWPD were more likely to be Medicaid-eligible (4.95 percentage points, p<0.001), but take-up rates were comparable. Enrollment assistance may improve supplemental coverage for PWPD around dementia onset, potentially increasing financial access to care.

35605.title: Search and Negotiation with Biased Beliefs in Consumer Credit Markets
35605.zh_title: 消费信贷市场中的搜索、谈判与有偏信念
35605.authors: Erik Berwart, Sean K. Higgins, Sheisha Kulkarni, Santiago Truffa
35605.zh_abstract_excerpt: 关于利率分布的有偏信念如何影响消费信贷市场中的搜索、谈判和贷款条款？我们与智利金融监管机构合作，对112,063名贷款申请者进行了一项随机对照试验。随机引出关于利率的信念导致参与者搜索更多并获得更低的利率。大多数参与者低估了利率水平和离散度。向他们展示我们使用全量消费贷款行政数据构建的价格比较工具，导致他们更新信念，进行更多谈判，在不增加搜索的情况下获得更低的利率，并且更有可能获得贷款。
35605.abstract: How do biased beliefs about the interest rate distribution affect search, negotiation, and loan terms in consumer credit markets? In collaboration with Chile's financial regulator, we conducted a randomized controlled trial with 112,063 loan seekers. Randomly eliciting beliefs about interest rates led participants to search more and obtain lower rates. Most participants underestimated both interest rate levels and dispersion. Showing them a price comparison tool we built using administrative data on the universe of consumer loans caused them to update their beliefs, negotiate more, obtain lower rates without searching more, and be more likely to take out a loan.

35604.title: Algorithm-Driven SVARs: Navigating the Wilderness of Big Data
35604.zh_title: 算法驱动的SVAR：穿越大数据荒野
35604.zh_abstract_excerpt: 每个SVAR结果都取决于两个选择：识别冲击的约束以及这些约束所作用的变量。文献对前者进行了规范；后者则是手工选择的。我们开发了一种贝叶斯方法，该方法构建信息集，使用样本外标准，并保留其允许的最大系统。在递归识别下，产出随住房生产而非仅家庭信贷而上升。对于货币政策，一个无锚定的、使用多个工具变量的联合贝叶斯代理SVAR强化了信贷利差渠道。一个用选定的公司利差增强的核心系统识别出预期违约风险是一个强有力的传导边际。
35604.abstract: Every SVAR result is conditional on two choices: the restrictions that identify the shock and the variables on which they operate. The literature disciplines the first; the second is chosen by hand. We develop a Bayesian methodology that constructs information sets, uses an out-of-sample criterion, and retains the largest system it admits. Under recursive identification, output rises with housing production rather than household credit alone. For monetary policy, an anchor-free joint Bayesian proxy SVAR with multiple instruments strengthens the credit spread channel. A core system augmented with the selected corporate spread identifies expected default risk as a potent transmission margin.

35603.title: Teen Suicide and the Outcomes of Surviving Peers
35603.zh_title: 青少年自杀与幸存同伴的结果
35603.authors: Emily Cuddy, Janet Currie, Elisa Jácome, Lucy Manly
35603.zh_abstract_excerpt: 到17岁时，四分之一的美国学生经历过同伴自杀。利用南卡罗来纳州的关联行政数据和匹配的双重差分设计，我们发现，接触同伴的自杀死亡会使自伤诊断的概率增加近50%，并增加心理健康就诊的发生率和频率。对护理使用和犯罪行为的影响集中在白人男孩中，且反应因先前的心理健康史而异：没有先前诊断的学生增加了重罪犯罪而非寻求护理。袭击和交通事故造成的死亡并未导致自伤的类似增加，这与传染效应一致。
35603.abstract: By age 17, a quarter of U.S. students have experienced a peer suicide. Using linked administrative data from South Carolina and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that exposure to a peer's self-harm death increases the probability of a self-harm diagnosis by nearly 50% and both the incidence and frequency of mental health visits. Effects on care use and criminal behavior are concentrated among white boys, and responses diverge by prior mental health history: students without a prior diagnosis increase felony offending rather than care-seeking. Deaths from assault and transportation accidents produce no comparable rise in self-harm, consistent with contagion.

35602.title: Colleges, Assortative Mating, and Intergenerational Mobility in Twentieth-Century America
35602.zh_title: 大学、选型婚配与二十世纪美国的代际流动性
35602.authors: Ran Abramitzky, Santiago Pérez, Joseph Price
35602.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用新近数字化的1915–1943年间美国60所男女同校大学120万名学生的记录，并将其与截至1963年其子女的入学记录进行匹配，来研究大学如何塑造婚姻匹配以及教育优势的代际传递。约有6%的男性和9%的女性与来自同一所大学的人结婚。这种同质性婚配在很大程度上是因果性的：在大学内部，更多异性同学以及更长的校园重叠时间都会提高同校婚姻的概率。同校配偶的教育程度更高，且这一优势会延续到下一代。
35602.abstract: We use newly digitized records for 1.2 million students at 60 co-educational U.S. colleges, 1915–1943, linked to enrollment records for their children through 1963, to study how colleges shape marital matching and the intergenerational transmission of educational advantage. About 6% of men and 9% of women marry someone from their own college. This homogamy is largely causal: within colleges, more different-sex classmates and longer campus overlap both raise same-college marriage. Same-college spouses are more educated, and this advantage persists across generations. Children of same-college couples more often attend selective colleges, with spousal education explaining a third of the gap.

35601.title: The Impact of Suicide Hotlines on Health: Evidence from 988 Implementation
35601.zh_title: 自杀热线对健康的影响：来自988实施的经验证据
35601.authors: Benjamin Hansen, Niketana Kannan, Jonathan Zhang
35601.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文考察了《国家自杀热线指定法案》的影响，该法案于2022年7月引入了通用的988呼叫代码，并指定联邦资金用于自杀危机呼叫中心。我们采用双重差分设计，利用各州在危机热线容量缺口方面的既有差异，该缺口以988实施前路由至某州但未在该州接听的呼叫数量来衡量。该法案的推出显著改善了基线容量缺口较大州的危机热线运营：这些州接听了更多本州呼叫，并提高了本州接听率。然而，这些运营上的改善并未转化为可检测到的自杀死亡率下降。
35601.abstract: This paper examines the impact of the National Suicide Hotline Designation Act, which introduced the universal 988 calling code and earmarked federal funding to suicide crisis call centers in July 2022. We use a difference-in-differences design that leverages pre-existing cross-state variation in crisis line capacity gaps, measured by the number of pre-988 calls routed to a state but not answered in-state. The rollout substantially improved crisis line operations in states with larger baseline capacity gaps: these states answered more calls in-state and increased their in-state answer rates. However, these operational gains did not translate into detectable reductions in suicide mortality. The mortality estimates are precise enough to rule out even modest short-run reductions. We also find no statistically significant improvements in broader population mental health outcomes. These findings suggest that expanding crisis line capacity alone may be insufficient to reduce suicide deaths.

35600.title: Recall Fluency, Beliefs and Behavior
35600.zh_title: 回忆流畅性、信念与行为
35600.authors: Pedro Bordalo, Nicola Gennaioli, Matthew O'Brien, Andrei Shleifer
35600.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国健康与退休研究收集了参与者回忆流畅性（RF）的数据，即他们从列表中回忆单词的能力，这是心理学家使用的标准记忆测量指标。在控制了多种人口统计学特征以及智商之后，回忆流畅性较高的人对股票回报、房屋价格和预期寿命更为乐观。我们推导了一个标准记忆模型的预测，并发现与这些预测一致的是，回忆流畅性较高的人对每个目标领域的信念对线索、对该领域的经验以及与其他领域（尤其是与目标领域相似的领域）无关的经验都更为敏感。这些效应进而传导至投资和退休选择。
35600.abstract: The US Health and Retirement Study collects data on participants’ recall fluency (RF), their ability to recall words from a list, a standard measure of memory used by psychologists. Controlling for multiple demographic characteristics as well as IQ, people with a higher RF are more optimistic about stock returns, the price of their homes, and their life expectancy. We derive the predictions of a standard memory model and find that, consistent with them, the beliefs of higher RF people about each target domain are more sensitive to cues, to experiences in that domain, but also to irrelevant experiences in other domains, especially those similar to the target. These effects, in turn, carry to investment and retirement choices. RF emerges as an economically relevant personal trait.

35659.zh_title: SNAP含糖饮料限制对消费和福利的影响
35659.authors: Hunt Allcott, Amy Finkelstein, Anna Grummon, Matthew J. Notowidigdo
35659.zh_abstract_excerpt: 截至2026年7月，已有23个州批准了禁止使用SNAP福利购买含糖饮料的政策。然而，此类限制对消费的影响尚不明确，因为大多数家庭可以简单地改用非SNAP资金购买含糖饮料。利用全国杂货购买面板数据，采用双重差分设计，我们估计前10个州的限制措施在2026年上半年使平均SNAP家庭对受限饮料的零售购买量减少了12.4%（标准误=1.0）。在仅排除部分含糖饮料的州，SNAP家庭部分转向了未被排除的饮料。
35659.abstract: As of July 2026, 23 states had approved policies that disallow spending of SNAP benefits on sugary drinks. The effects of such restrictions on consumption are unclear, however, since most households can simply switch to buying sugary drinks with non-SNAP funds. Using a difference-in- differences design with nationwide grocery purchase panel data, we estimate that restrictions in the first 10 states reduced the average SNAP household’s retail purchases of excluded drinks by 12.4 percent (standard error = 1.0) over the first half of 2026. In states that excluded only some sugary drinks, SNAP households partially substituted to non-excluded drinks. Surveys we carried out before and after implementation show that the restrictions increased SNAP recipients’ perceptions of stigma. We combine our estimated consumption reductions with external parameters to model welfare effects given an over-consumption internality and a fiscal externality via public health care spending. In our model, excluding all sugary drinks from SNAP nationwide would provide benefits of about $1.1 billion per year, of which about 70 percent is from reduced health care costs.

35658.title: Measuring the Welfare Gains from Cardinal-Preference Mechanisms in School Choice
35658.zh_title: 衡量择校中基数偏好机制的福利收益
35658.authors: Hülya Eraslan, Jeremy T. Fox, YingHua He
35658.zh_abstract_excerpt: 序数机制使用排名但不使用偏好强度。基数机制还引出学校效用，使其能够利用学生对分配彩票的偏好。我们将概率序列机制与四种基数机制进行比较，这些机制在依次更强的限制下最大化相同的福利目标：仅容量限制、ε-无嫉妒、无嫉妒，以及福利最大化的基数偏好伪市场。由于可行集是嵌套的，随着限制从仅容量到近似无嫉妒、精确无嫉妒，再到具有共同价格的平等预算，最大福利弱下降。我们建立了关于大市场说真话的正反结果。
35658.abstract: Ordinal mechanisms use rankings but not preference intensities. Cardinal mechanisms also elicit school utilities, allowing them to use students’ preferences over assignment lotteries. We compare probabilistic serial with four cardinal mechanisms that maximize the same welfare objective under successively stronger restrictions: capacity-only, ε-envy-free, envy-free, and a welfare-maximizing cardinal-preference pseudomarket. Because the feasible sets are nested, maximum welfare weakly falls as the restrictions tighten from capacity alone to approximate no-envy, exact no-envy, and equal budgets with common prices. We establish positive and negative results on large-market truthtelling. All 44 theorem parts in the paper are machine-checked in the Lean 4 proof assistant. We develop methods for computing cardinal-preference pseudomarket equilibria for Seattle’s 898 students and 11 schools. Using set-identified cardinal preferences from Seattle high-school choice data, we estimate that, under exact capacity, capacity-only raises mean welfare over probabilistic serial by 0.053, equivalent to shifting 5.3 percentage points of assignment probability from the average student’s worst school to the top school. Exact envy-freeness retains 79% of this gain; best-found pseudomarket equilibria yield a mean gain of 0.002. The estimates show both the value of cardinal information and the welfare cost of pseudomarket fairness restrictions.

35657.title: The Data Revolution, and Its Uses, in International Trade
35657.zh_title: 国际贸易中的数据革命及其应用
35657.zh_abstract_excerpt: 近几十年来，研究国际贸易的经济学家获得了前所未有的海量和多样化的数据。这些数据提供了新的见解，并加深了对贸易机制的理解。通过分析大量论文，我们记录了研究性质的变化。以前，典型的贸易论文要么是纯理论性的，要么是检验理论预测的实证论文。最近，学术研究转向了更综合的方法，特别是定量建模。这一发展令人惊讶。我们可能预期数据革命（以及同时期的可信度革命）会增加纯实证论文的比例——尽管这些革命的标志在实证工作中因果推断的兴起中清晰可见。
35657.abstract: In recent decades, economists studying international trade have gained access to an unprecedented volume and variety of data. These data have provided new insights and a more granular understanding of the mechanics of trade. Analyzing a large corpus of papers, we document that the nature of research has also shifted. Previously, the typical trade paper was either purely theoretical or an empirical paper testing theoretical predictions. More recently, scholarship has shifted toward a more integrated approach, particularly quantitative modeling. This development is surprising. We might have expected the data revolution (and contemporaneous credibility revolution) to increase the share of primarily empirical papers—although the markers of these revolutions are clearly evident in the rise of causal inference within empirical work. This article reviews these developments, assessing the strengths and limitations of different modes of inquiry, and plotting a path forward to harness the growing richness of data within the field.

35656.title: Cultural Evolution
35656.authors: Oded Galor, Marc Klemp, Daniel C. Wainstock
35656.zh_abstract_excerpt: 是什么导致了全球文化表现形式的马赛克式多样性？为什么有些社会的文化多样性比其他社会更高？本研究发展了一个统一的文化演化理论，描述了在人类生存过程中主导这一过程的力量。研究提出假设：人口流动和社会经济转型导致了遗传的文化特质与主流生态和社会条件之间的不匹配，从而启动了一个由基于适应的垂直传播、水平扩散和基于适应度的演化选择所支配的演化过程。该理论对全球文化马赛克的起源和跨社会文化多样性差异产生了新的可检验预测。
35656.abstract: What gave rise to the mosaic of cultural expressions across the globe? Why are some societies more culturally diverse than others? This study develops a unified theory of cultural evolution, characterizing the forces that have governed this process over the course of human existence. The research advances the hypothesis that population movements and socioeconomic transformations generated a mismatch between inherited cultural traits and prevailing ecological and societal conditions, setting in motion an evolutionary process governed by adaptation-based vertical transmission, horizontal diffusion, and fitness-based evolutionary selection. The theory generates novel testable predictions concerning the origins of the global cultural mosaic and the cross-societal variation in cultural diversity. First, greater ecological distance between ancestral environments generated greater cultural distance across societies. Second, prehistoric differences in ancestral diversity contributed to divergent adaptive capacity and greater cultural distance. Third, societies descended from more diverse prehistoric populations exhibit greater cultural diversity despite convergence induced by adaptation to a common environment and societal norms. Drawing on measures of cultural distance and diversity derived from folkloric and musical traditions among ethnic groups, visual representations of common concepts, and the dispersion of norms, values, and attitudes, the empirical analysis lends credence to the predictions of the theory.

35655.title: Crypto Capture of Foreign Aid
35655.zh_title: 对外援助的加密货币捕获
35655.authors: Sumit Agarwal, Peiyi Jin, Eswar S. Prasad, Daniel Rabetti
35655.zh_abstract_excerpt: 2016年巴拿马文件泄露加强了围绕洗钱和离岸银行业务的监管执法。我们调查了发展中国家对外援助的转移是否导致了向加密货币作为替代洗钱平台的转变。我们开发了一种基于支付时间的法证加密货币活动度量方法，结合链上比特币交易和钱包创建、链下交易所记录以及IP关联的网络流量，并将其应用于世界银行援助支付，覆盖我们2018-2024年估计样本中93个受援国的2380亿美元。
35655.abstract: The 2016 Panama Papers leak tightened regulatory enforcement around money laundering and offshore banking. We investigate whether the diversion of foreign aid in developing countries led to a shift to cryptocurrency as an alternative laundering platform. We develop a disbursement-timed forensic measure of cryptocurrency activity, combining on-chain Bitcoin transactions and wallet creation, off-chain exchange records, and IP-linked web traffic, and apply it to World Bank aid disbursements covering $238 billion across the 93 recipient countries in our estimation sample during 2018-2024. Exploiting the administrative timing of aid tranche arrivals, we find sharp, short-lived surges of crypto activity at the disbursement month, driven mainly by anonymous and newly created wallets on both tax-haven and mainstream exchanges. Blockchain forensics reveal patterns consistent with the placement, layering, and integration sequence of conventional money laundering. We estimate an implied leakage of 2 to 6 cents per aid dollar, which amounts to roughly 1.7 to 4.4 billion dollars of aid diversion across the tranche arrivals we study. Capture carries no funding penalty: the four sectors where we detect it, Transport, Water and Sanitation, Social Protection, and Governance, still absorb half of subsequent World Bank funding. Cryptocurrency facilitates aid diversion, but its transparent ledgers also leave forensic traces that may help detect and recover diverted funds.
35655.zh_abstract: 2016年巴拿马文件泄露加强了围绕洗钱和离岸银行业务的监管执法。我们调查了发展中国家对外援助的转移是否导致了向加密货币作为替代洗钱平台的转变。我们开发了一种基于支付时间的法证加密货币活动度量方法，结合链上比特币交易和钱包创建、链下交易所记录以及IP关联的网络流量，并将其应用于世界银行援助支付，覆盖我们2018-2024年估计样本中93个受援国的2380亿美元。利用援助款项到账的行政时间安排，我们发现支付月份加密货币活动出现急剧、短暂的激增，主要由匿名和新创建的钱包驱动，这些钱包同时出现在避税天堂和主流交易所。区块链取证揭示了与传统洗钱的放置、分层和整合阶段一致的模式。我们估计每援助美元隐含泄漏2至6美分，这相当于在我们研究的款项到账期间，大约17亿至44亿美元的援助转移。捕获行为不带来资金惩罚：我们检测到捕获的四个部门，即交通、供水和卫生、社会保护和治理，仍然吸收了世界银行后续资金的一半。加密货币促进了援助转移，但其透明账本也留下了法证痕迹，可能有助于检测和追回被转移的资金。

35654.title: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
35654.zh_title: 关键矿产、地缘政治与绿色转型
35654.authors: Tomás Domínguez-Iino, Jonathan T. Elliott, Allan Hsiao
35654.zh_abstract_excerpt: 绿色能源转型将由锂、镍和钴的开采和加工推动，这些矿产对于先进电池的生产至关重要。这些矿产在地理上集中，但在全球范围内交易，使得主要采矿国能够通过政策干预行使市场力量。先进电池组合使用多种矿产，这种联合使用造成了矿产市场之间的相互依赖。我们研究了这些力量的地缘政治影响及其对全球绿色技术采用的后果。我们量化了供应链脆弱性、国际政策溢出效应以及矿产卡特尔的可能性。
35654.abstract: The green energy transition will be powered by the mining and processing of lithium, nickel, and cobalt, which are critical for the production of advanced batteries. These minerals are concentrated geographically but traded globally, allowing key mining countries to exercise market power through policy intervention. Advanced batteries use multiple minerals in combination, and this joint use creates interdependence across mineral markets. We study the geopolitical implications of these forces and their consequences for green technology adoption worldwide. We quantify supply chain vulnerability, international policy spillovers, and the potential for mineral cartels.

35653.title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
35653.zh_title: 征税还是削减？财政整顿中的边际税收与支出乘数
35653.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们引入了边际累积乘数的概念——即在保持另一财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响——并将其应用于一个著名的财政整顿事件面板数据集，该数据集涵盖1978-2020年间16个国家。在我们的基准设定中，我们估计两年期的边际支出乘数为1.5，边际税收乘数接近于0。我们还通过应用McKay和Wolf（2023）的政策反事实方法估计了类似的乘数。在广泛的稳健性分析中，我们从未发现支出乘数低于1.3或税收乘数高于-1的情况。
35653.abstract: We introduce the notion of marginal cumulative multiplier — the effect of either government spending or taxation on output holding the other fiscal instrument constant — and apply it to a well known panel of consolidation episodes in 16 countries in the period 1978-2020. In our benchmark specification we estimate a marginal spending multiplier at two years of 1.5 and a marginal tax multiplier close to 0. We also estimate similar multipliers by applying the policy counterfactual method of McKay and Wolf (2023). In an extensive robustness analysis we never find spending multipliers below 1.3 or tax multipliers higher than -1. These findings are seemingly in contrast to those of much of the existing literature on fiscal multipliers, which typically finds higher tax than spending multipliers. We show that this contradiction disappears once the fiscal variables used in the literature are scaled by the proper factor.
35653.zh_abstract: 我们引入了边际累积乘数的概念——即在保持另一财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响——并将其应用于一个著名的财政整顿事件面板数据集，该数据集涵盖1978-2020年间16个国家。在我们的基准设定中，我们估计两年期的边际支出乘数为1.5，边际税收乘数接近于0。我们还通过应用McKay和Wolf（2023）的政策反事实方法估计了类似的乘数。在广泛的稳健性分析中，我们从未发现支出乘数低于1.3或税收乘数高于-1的情况。这些发现似乎与现有财政乘数文献中的大部分结论相矛盾，后者通常发现税收乘数高于支出乘数。我们表明，一旦文献中使用的财政变量按适当的因子进行缩放，这一矛盾就会消失。

35652.title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
35652.zh_title: 全球企业与资本市场模型
35652.authors: Loukas Karabarbounis, Bruno Pellegrino, Juliana Salomao
35652.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们构建了一个全球经济的一般均衡模型，该模型将产品市场中竞争的异质性企业与在全球范围内配置资本的国家相结合。通过将产品方的享乐需求系统与资产方的均值-方差投资组合系统相结合，我们获得了模型均衡的近似闭式解。我们利用企业层面的资产负债表数据、收入和就业的地理分布数据以及业务描述，结合国家层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，将模型量化到48个国家约23,000家上市公司的横截面上。我们利用该模型评估全球化的重新配置效应和福利效应。
35652.abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.

35651.title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family

35651.authors: Raquel Fernández, Inés Berniell, Milagros Onofri
35651.zh_abstract_excerpt: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率都在下降。人们也报告希望生育更少的孩子：在2012年至2022年间，理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，而在类似时期内，表示打算在三年内生育孩子的受访者比例从28%降至21%。原因何在？利用两项跨国调查（每项调查大约相隔十年进行了两次），询问受访者的态度和生育偏好，我们将每次下降分解为一系列广泛且相互竞争的态度所做出的贡献。有三点尤为突出：儿童日益被视为干扰父母的自由；
35651.abstract: Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.

35650.title: The Meritocratic Consensus and Stratification in Higher Education
35650.zh_title: 精英共识与高等教育分层
35650.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国的学院和大学在入学前的学业成绩、家庭背景和机构资源方面高度分层。我们研究了美国高等教育中的精英共识：高分学生（通常也来自高收入家庭）就读的大学在教学上的支出远高于录取低分学生的大学。自1960年代以来，按考试成绩的分层基本保持稳定，但自1970年以来，私立和公立机构的教学资源分层急剧上升。非学术录取标准，如体育、传承录取和平权行动，在决定学生分配到大学方面是次要的。
35650.abstract: American colleges and universities are highly stratified by pre-college academic achievement, family background, and institutional resources. We study the meritocratic consensus in American higher education: colleges that high-testing students (who are generally also from high-income families) attend spend dramatically more on instruction than do those that enroll lower-testing students. Stratification by test scores has been largely stable since the 1960s, but the stratification of instructional resources has risen sharply since 1970 at both private and public institutions. Non-academic admissions criteria like athletics, legacy, and affirmative action are second-order in determining the allocation of students to universities. Potential economic justifications for the positive association of instructional expenditures with student prior achievement—q-complementarity between achievement and resources, convex social returns to high human capital, and incentives to invest in learning prior to college—have little empirical support. Resource stratification across universities has not increased in the past decade, largely due to increased public funding of universities that enroll lower-testing students through financial aid programs like California's CalGrant, but stratification within institutions is now rising swiftly.

35649.title: The Effect of Childcare on Female Labor Supply and Child Development in Low and Middle Income Countries

35649.zh_abstract_excerpt: 托育服务可以为女性提供发展职业生涯和增加家庭收入的机会。同时，根据照护质量的不同，它也可能影响儿童的发展。我们首先构建了一个家庭集体模型作为概念框架，以展示改善托育服务的可及性如何影响母亲的劳动力市场机会和收入，以及它如何影响儿童发展。然后，我们回顾了关于托育服务对女性就业和收入以及儿童发展影响的文献。托育服务可以增加母亲的就业。然而，有限的工作机会或对母亲工作的严格规范可能使母亲留在劳动力市场之外。
35649.abstract: Childcare services can offer an opportunity for women to develop their careers and increase household income. At the same time, it can affect the development of children, depending on the quality of care. We first develop a collective model of the household as a conceptual framework to show how improving the availability of childcare can affect mothers’ labor market opportunities and earnings and how it can affect child development. We then review the literature on the effects of childcare on the employment and earnings of women and on child development. Childcare can increase mothers’ employment. However, limited work opportunities or strict norms against maternal work can keep mothers out of the labor force. When other family members provide care, childcare can free these caregivers to work or attend school. When studies measure the impact on child development, the results are mixed and depend on both context and quality of provision.

35648.title: Do Local Synthetic Opioid Overdose Deaths Affect Provider Prescribing of Buprenorphine?
35648.zh_title: 地方合成阿片类药物过量死亡是否影响医生开具丁丙诺啡处方？
35648.authors: Nicole Siegal, Sumedha Gupta, Matthew C. Aalsma, Stephen Crystal, Jennifer Miles, Hillary Samples, Allen Campbell, Kosali I. Simon, Rosalie Liccardo Pacula
35648.zh_abstract_excerpt: 用于治疗阿片类药物使用障碍的丁丙诺啡处方量仍远低于过量危机的规模。我们利用2013年至2023年合成阿片类药物在地理上的交错扩散，估计了县级合成阿片类药物过量死亡率冲击对丁丙诺啡治疗量的因果效应。将IQVIA纵向处方索赔数据与国家生命统计系统的死亡率记录相链接，我们在三种互补的暴露度量下实施了带有倾向得分匹配的双重差分估计器。在所有三种定义下，治疗量均显著增加，且没有证据表明存在差异性的前期趋势；
35648.abstract: Buprenorphine prescribing for opioid use disorder remains far below the scale of the overdose crisis. We estimate the causal effect of county-level synthetic opioid overdose mortality shocks on the volume of buprenorphine treatment delivered, exploiting the staggered geographic diffusion of synthetic opioids from 2013 to 2023. Linking IQVIA Longitudinal Prescription Claims to National Vital Statistics System mortality records, we implement a difference-in-differences estimator with propensity score matching under three complementary exposure measures. Treatment volume increases significantly under all three definitions, with no evidence of differential pre-trends; point estimates for buprenorphine prescribing rates range from 5 to 17 percent of pre-treatment means, emerge within one to two quarters, and grow monotonically thereafter. Our design does not separately identify changes in patient demand and provider behavior, but the increase in unique prescribers is consistent with a provider-side response. The response is concentrated among advanced practice providers, Medicaid patients, and counties with pre-existing buprenorphine infrastructure; counties with little baseline prescribing show no response. Local mortality information acts as a determinant of treatment volume, with effects comparable in magnitude to major legislative interventions aimed at expanding treatment, but appear only where prescribing capacity already exists.

35647.title: Currency Dominance Is Not Forever: Some Insights from a Non-Linear Dynamic Model
35647.zh_title: 货币主导地位并非永恒：来自非线性动态模型的一些见解
35647.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提出了一种基于具有制度切换的原创国际货币体系（IMS）模型的压力测试方法。该模型以古典金本位制开始至今的九种参考货币进行校准。货币主导地位中的制度切换与一个包含五类冲击的多维环境变量的条件组合相关：技术；发展；货币、金融和财政制度；民主与冲突；以及监管环境。我们为这五类冲击提供了一个原创的事件数据库，用于校准。校准结果凸显了民主与冲突成分在制度切换中的重要作用。随后，校准后的模型被用于对广泛情景下当前货币主导地位前景进行压力测试。
35647.abstract: We propose stress tests based on an original International Monetary System (IMS) model with regime switchings. The model is calibrated for nine reference currencies from the beginning of the Classical Gold Standard to the present. Regime switchings in currency dominance are related to combinations of conditions on a multidimensional environment variable that includes five classes of shocks: technology; development; monetary, financial and fiscal institutions; democracy and conflicts; and the regulatory environment. We provide an original database of events for these five classes of shocks, which is used for calibration. The calibration highlights the important role of the democracy and conflicts component in regime switchings. The calibrated model is then used to perform stress tests on the current prospects of currency dominance for a broad set of scenarios. A salient result from the scenarios we tested is that the dominance of the US dollar is at most marginally affected. No other currency emerges as a major player, suggesting strong inertia in the system’s current centripetal dynamics.

35645.title: Stress Testing Cardiac Care Markets through Deregulation
35645.zh_title: 通过放松管制对心脏护理市场进行压力测试
35645.authors: Daniel R. Arnold, Michael R. Richards, Yashaswini Singh, Christopher M. Whaley
35645.zh_abstract_excerpt: 技术创新的扩散取决于激励、法规和企业的战略行为。我们研究了心脏手术市场中这些因素的交叉点，背景是医疗保险（Medicare）因临床进步而扩大了非医院设施的治疗选择。州级法规限制了联邦促进竞争的政策。在市场进入发生的地方，业务窃取集中在成本最低的治疗环境中，而不是高成本医院——这使医疗保险支出增加了约250万美元。医疗保险政策还对未针对的手术和其他支付方产生外部性，除非医院和医生是垂直整合的。
35645.abstract: The diffusion of technological innovation depends on incentives, regulations, and firms’ strategic behaviors. We study these intersections within cardiac procedure markets following Medicare’s expansion of non-hospital facility options for treatment, enabled by clinical advancements. State-level regulations restrain federal pro-competition policy. Where market entry occurs, business stealing is concentrated among the lowest cost treatment settings, rather than high-cost hospitals––increasing Medicare spending by approximately $2.5 million. Medicare policy also generates externalities for untargeted procedures and other payers, except when hospitals and physicians are vertically integrated. Federal rulemaking interacts with and is mitigated by complex market dynamics––including in potentially unanticipated ways.

35644.title: Where the Grass Seems Greener: Economic Misperceptions and Support for Democracy
35644.zh_title: 草更绿之处：经济误解与对民主的支持
35644.authors: Daron Acemoglu, Nicolas Ajzenman, Guillermo Cruces, Martin Fiszbein, Gaston Garcia Zavaleta, Carlos Molina
35644.zh_abstract_excerpt: 尽管有证据表明民粹主义和威权政权在经济上往往表现不佳，但全球对其支持率正在上升。我们利用阿根廷2023年总统选举期间的两次调查实验（共11,377名受访者），考察了（错误）认知对政权表现的作用，将其视为政治态度的驱动因素。对民粹主义和非民主政权表现的乐观信念普遍存在，并与对这些政权的支持表现出强相关性。
35644.abstract: Support for populist and authoritarian regimes is rising worldwide, despite evidence that they tend to underperform economically. We examine the role of (mis)perceptions of regime performance as drivers of political attitudes, leveraging two survey experiments with 11,377 respondents during Argentina’s 2023 presidential elections. Optimistic beliefs about the performance of populist and non-democratic regimes were widespread, and displayed a strong correlation with support for these regimes. When exposed to randomly assigned informational treatments challenging optimistic views about these political regimes, individuals significantly adjusted their beliefs, and reduced their support for candidates they associate with populist and authoritarian leanings. Exploring the impact of different information sources, we find that academic sources and newspapers were more influential than social media. Although individuals adjusted their beliefs and attitudes in response to information on regime performance, contradicting their prior beliefs reduced their demand for additional information, consistent with an important role for motivated reasoning.
35644.zh_abstract: 尽管有证据表明民粹主义和威权政权在经济上往往表现不佳，但全球对其支持率正在上升。我们利用阿根廷2023年总统选举期间的两次调查实验（共11,377名受访者），考察了（错误）认知对政权表现的作用，将其视为政治态度的驱动因素。对民粹主义和非民主政权表现的乐观信念普遍存在，并与对这些政权的支持表现出强相关性。当接触到随机分配的信息处理，挑战对这些政治政权的乐观看法时，个体显著调整了他们的信念，并减少了对他们与民粹主义和威权倾向相关联的候选人的支持。探索不同信息来源的影响，我们发现学术来源和报纸比社交媒体更具影响力。尽管个体根据政权表现的信息调整了他们的信念和态度，但与他们先前信念相矛盾的信息减少了对额外信息的需求，这与动机性推理的重要作用一致。

35643.title: Survival Analysis with Limited Overlap and Censoring Distribution Shift
35643.zh_title: 有限重叠和删失分布偏移下的生存分析
35643.authors: Meera Krishnamoorthy, Donna Tjandra, Divya Shanmugam, Amanda E. Kowalski, Jenna Wiens
35643.zh_abstract_excerpt: 生存分析方法常用于预测事件发生的时间，在训练期间真实事件发生时间（TTE）可能被删失的情况下。此类方法通常假设未删失数据代表删失数据，并且给定协变量的删失概率随时间保持不变，即不存在删失分布偏移。然而，当删失源于针对具有特定合并症或遗传标记的个体的干预（例如预测癌症发病时间时的预防性手术，或预测自然临产时间时的计划剖宫产和引产）以及临床政策变化改变这些干预的目标个体时，这两个假设在实践中都可能失效。
35643.abstract: Survival analysis methods are often used to predict the time until the onset of an event in settings when the true time-to-event (TTE) may be censored during training. Such approaches typically assume uncensored data are representative of censored data and that the probability of censoring conditioned on the covariates remains constant over time, i.e., there is no censoring distribution shift. However, both assumptions can fail in practice when censoring results from interventions targeted to individuals with particular comorbidities or genetic markers (such as prophylactic surgery when predicting time to cancer onset, or scheduled cesarean delivery and induction when predicting time to spontaneous labor) and changes in clinical policies alter which individuals are targeted for these interventions over time. To address this, we propose a new approach, cluster-weighted inference of time-to event (CWITE), that remains accurate when these assumptions do not hold. Unlike existing approaches that ignore times-to-censoring (TTC) or treat them only as a lower bound of the TTE, CWITE leverages the insight that a subset of censored individuals are likely censored close to their true TTEs, and uses a novel mechanism to learn from such individuals. 35642.title: Monetary-Fiscal Interactions: A Reappraisal

35642.authors: George-Marios Angeletos, Chen Lian, Christian K. Wolf, Dalton Rongxuan Zhang
35642.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在代表性代理人新凯恩斯模型（RANK）中，财政主导的可能性取决于收入永久由需求决定的假设：在该模型中，财政赤字只有在引发无限持续、自我维持的总支出和收入变化时才能推动产出和通胀。转向异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型（HANK）开辟了一条不同的途径：由于有限视野或流动性约束导致的古典非李嘉图效应。
35642.abstract: The possibility of fiscal dominance in the representative-agent New Keynesian model (RANK) hinges on the assumption that income is perpetually demand-determined: fiscal deficits can drive output and inflation within that model only insofar as they trigger infinitely lasting, self-sustained shifts in aggregate spending and income. Moving to heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian models (HANK) opens the door to a different pathway: classical non-Ricardian effects, due to finite horizons or liquidity constraints. A refinement motivated by the model's intended focus on short-run phenomena—requiring a return to flexible-price outcomes in finite time—arrests the infinite feedback loop between spending and income, leaving only the classical non-Ricardian mechanism, and makes sure that the study of monetary-fiscal interactions is not centered on hard-to-test assumptions regarding beliefs at infinity.

35641.zh_abstract_excerpt: 公共人工智能基准引导研究并分配投资。因此，它们是市场设计。公共示例可以揭示私人最终测试背后的过程，而有限的公共分数无法覆盖通用智能固有的广泛任务空间。我展示了当分数驱动资本时，这两个缺口如何变得有利可图，以及有针对性的努力如何侵蚀后来投资者使用的信号。市场设计的教训是将开发与认证分开：发布实践任务，但在提交系统的评估策略固定后，选择影响投资的生成器。

35640.title: Labor Market Power with Worker and Firm Heterogeneity
35640.zh_title: 具有工人与企业异质性的劳动力市场势力
35640.authors: David W. Berger, Kyle F. Herkenhoff, Jaehun Jeong, Simon Mongey
35640.zh_abstract_excerpt: 企业如何设定工资？政府应如何设定所得税？如果劳动力供给对工资无弹性，企业可以支付给工人的工资低于其边际产出，政府也可以提高税收而不会侵蚀税基。然而，经济中劳动力供给弹性的结构是复杂的。最近的实证研究记录了工人、企业和边际（选择在哪家企业工作与选择工作多少小时）之间的差异。为了解释劳动力供给弹性这种丰富的结构，我们将新古典模型扩展为包含对在哪家企业工作的离散选择、生产互补性以及异质性、颗粒型企业之间的战略互动。
35640.abstract: How do firms set wages? How should governments set income taxes? If labor supply is inelastic to wages, firms can pay workers less than their marginal products, and governments can increase taxes without eroding the base. However, the structure of labor supply elasticities in the economy is complex. Recent empirics document variation across workers, firms, and margins (which firm to work at versus how many hours to work). To account for this rich structure of labor supply elasticities we extend the neoclassical model to include a discrete choice over which firm to work at, production complementarities and strategic interaction between heterogeneous, granular firms. In terms of wage setting, we find that novel effects of worker heterogeneity account for 78 percent of the variable component of labor supply elasticities and markdowns, and 89 percent of markdown differences between large and small firms. In terms of policy, higher progressivity makes labor supply less elastic, eroding the tax base by widening markdowns and worsening sorting. These channels (i) produce large declines in earnings following increases in marginal tax rates, consistent with empirical studies, and (ii) reduce optimal tax progressivity by one-third and associated welfare gains by two-thirds.

35639.title: Local Labor Demand and Achievement Gaps: Evidence from the Great Recession
