35639.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了在大衰退期间地方劳动力需求的收缩如何影响儿童的学业成就。我们将来自斯坦福教育数据档案的3-8年级县级考试成绩与一个转移份额设计相结合，该设计将各县2005年的行业构成与全国行业就业增长进行交互，从而分离出需求驱动的当地就业变化。遵循转移份额文献的最新进展，我们通过平衡性检验、预趋势检验和Rotemberg权重诊断来验证该设计，并全程报告暴露稳健标准误。一个标准差的不利冲击会使数学成绩降低约0.
35639.abstract: We examine how contractions in local labor demand during the Great Recession affected children's academic achievement. We combine county-level test scores for grades 3–8 from the Stanford Education Data Archive with a shift-share design that interacts counties' 2005 industry composition with national industry employment growth, isolating demand-driven changes in local employment. Following recent advances in the shift-share literature, we validate the design with balance, pre-trend, and Rotemberg-weight diagnostics and report exposure-robust standard errors throughout. A one-standard-deviation adverse shock lowers mathematics achievement by about 0.03 student-level standard deviations and widens the White–Black and economic-disadvantage achievement gaps in both subjects. Within a common geography, losses concentrate among economically disadvantaged students. English language arts estimates point in the same direction but are harder to separate from the Great Recession's housing bust, and we interpret them as the combined effect of the labor-demand contraction and the associated decline in house prices. The achievement response is concentrated in the recession window. The post-2014 period, identified mainly by the oil-price cycle, yields a precise null, so our estimates measure the response to severe contractions rather than a general business-cycle parameter. School funding did not respond contemporaneously to these shocks, while family income, child poverty, and house prices all did.

35638.title: Tracing the Impact of Payment Convenience on Deposits: Evidence from Depositor Activeness
35638.zh_title: 追踪支付便利性对存款的影响：来自存款人活跃度的证据
35638.authors: Xu Lu, Yang Song, Yao Zeng
35638.zh_abstract_excerpt: 银行转账有多慢，转账延迟如何影响存款需求？利用数百万存款人的交易级数据，我们通过匹配同一存款人在不同账户中的借方和贷方来测量转账延迟。较短的延迟与更多的转账和较低的余额相关。利用县级对Zelle分阶段推出的暴露度，我们发现更快的支付减少了延迟和存款增长。校准一个存款管理模型后，我们发现转账延迟提高了存款需求，并且这种效应的规模随利率和消费波动性而变化。因此，支付摩擦塑造了交易性存款需求和货币传导。
35638.abstract: How slow are bank transfers, and how do transfer delays affect deposit demand? Using transaction-level data from millions of depositors, we measure transfer delays by matching debits and credits across accounts held by the same depositor. Shorter delays correlate with more transfers and lower balances. Exploiting county-level exposure to Zelle’s staggered rollout, we find that faster payments reduce delays and deposit growth. Calibrating a deposit-management model, we find that transfer delays raise deposit demand, and the magnitude of this effect varies with interest rates and consumption volatility. Payment frictions therefore shape transactional deposit demand and monetary transmission.

35637.title: Political Entrepreneurs
35637.authors: Aaron Chatterji, Jorge Guzman, Joyce Ma, Ryan C. McDevitt
35637.zh_abstract_excerpt: 企业不仅通过游说和竞选捐款从外部塑造公共政策，而且当企业主担任公职时，也从内部塑造公共政策。我们利用一个新颖的数据集研究这一渠道，该数据集将2009年至2023年间美国26个州的州议员的个人财务披露与法案提案记录联系起来。这些披露使我们能够观察到立法服务期间的商业所有权，并将企业家（定义为既拥有又积极管理企业的立法者）与被动股东和雇员区分开来。
35637.abstract: Firms shape public policy not only from the outside through lobbying and campaign contributions, but also from the inside when business owners hold public office. We study this channel using a novel dataset that links state legislators’ personal financial disclosures to bill sponsorship records across 26 U.S. states from 2009 to 2023. The disclosures allow us to observe business ownership during legislative service and to distinguish entrepreneurs, defined as legislators who both own and actively manage a firm, from passive shareholders and employees. Applying a large language model to bill text, we classify legislation as pro-business and identify a subset of pro-entry bills that reduce barriers facing new firms. Entrepreneurs are a substantial presence in state legislatures, accounting for over 40 percent of legislators, and their representation varies primarily across states rather than within states over time. Although entrepreneurs do not sponsor more bills overall, they initiate a greater share of bills as first or sole primary sponsor. They also do not appear to be generic advocates for business. Relative to legislators with other business ties, entrepreneurs are no more likely to sponsor pro-business bills or bills endorsed by state Chambers of Commerce. Instead, they selectively advance pro-entry legislation, especially bills related to deregulation and innovation rather than antitrust or access to capital. These findings document an important channel through which entrepreneurs shape the policy environment for entrepreneurship from within political institutions.

35636.title: Rate Risk and Rate Insurance
35636.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我将股票收益分解为与久期匹配的国债部分（通过货币政策冲击识别）和支付部分。股票的风险和收益随久期的增加远低于其匹配的国债。股票波动率受到利率保险的抑制：利率在坏时期下降，因此股票内部的债券部分为股票支付风险提供保险。预期股票收益受到抑制，因为保险是反向运作的：利率在好时期上升，因此股票的支付收益对冲了投资者持有净久期（尤其是当李嘉图等价失效时的政府债券）所遭受的损失。

Risk and returns rise much less with duration for stocks than for their matched Treasuries. Stock volatility is dampened by rate insurance: rates fall in bad times, so the bond inside a stock provides insurance against the stock’s payoff risk. Expected stock returns are dampened because the insurance works in reverse: rates rise in good times, so stocks’ payoff gains hedge the losses borne by investors holding net duration, notably government bonds when Ricardian equivalence fails. This framework helps reconcile positive bond premia with negative stock-bond covariance, sheds light on equity anomalies and the collapse of the value premium, implies that fiscal and monetary policy shape bond and equity premia, and motivates a two-factor model that jointly prices stocks and bonds. Rate insurance can even turn the price of long-run risk negative, explaining why long bonds beat long stocks.

35635.title: Occupational Licensing of Uber Drivers
35635.authors: Jonathan Hall, Jason Hicks, Morris M. Kleiner, Yun taek Oh
35635.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用包含司机评级和基于远程信息处理的驾驶行为测量的Uber行程级数据，检验职业许可是否提高了服务质量和安全性。利用基于邻近调度的准随机分配，我们在两种情境下比较了持牌和未持牌司机服务的行程：纽约市和新泽西州之间的跨境比较，以及休斯顿的放松管制事件。在各种情境和规格中，包括工具变量估计，我们没有发现一致的证据表明许可改善了消费者结果。
35635.abstract: We examine whether occupational licensing improves service quality and safety using trip-level Uber data that include driver ratings and telematics-based measures of driving behavior. Exploiting quasi-random assignment from proximity-based dispatch, we compare trips served by licensed and unlicensed drivers in two settings: a cross-border comparison between New York City and New Jersey, and a deregulation event in Houston. Across settings and specifications, including instrumental variable estimates, we find no consistent evidence that licensing improves consumer outcomes. In Houston, post-deregulation entrants are indistinguishable from previously licensed drivers on ratings and driving behavior, despite differing markedly in experience and age.

35634.title: The Yeoman's Portfolio: Measuring Historical Risk Preferences Using Crop Choice
35634.zh_title: 自耕农的投资组合：利用作物选择衡量历史风险偏好
35634.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们设计了一种衡量遥远过去行为主体风险偏好的方法。该方法将作物选择的结构性模型作为投资组合配置，与基于历史农学和气候数据对预期作物收益的机器学习预测相结合。我们估算了美国县级风险偏好以及1889年至1929年堪萨斯州农场主层面的风险偏好。风险厌恶程度更高的农场主杠杆使用更少，购买新颖的第一次世界大战自由债券的可能性更低，而参与当地风险分担制度的可能性更高。我们表明，更高的风险厌恶程度预示着1920年代拖拉机采用和农业机械化的速度更慢。
35634.abstract: We design a method for measuring the risk preferences of agents in the deep past. The method combines a structural model of crop choice as a portfolio allocation with machine-learning prediction of expected crop returns, using historic agronomic and climate data. We estimate county-level risk preferences for the United States and farmer-level preferences in Kansas from 1889 to 1929. More risk averse farmers leveraged less, were less likely to purchase novel WWI Liberty Bonds, and were more likely to participate in local risk-sharing institutions. We show that higher risk aversion predicts slower tractor adoption and farm mechanization during the 1920s.

35633.title: Instrument Hacking
35633.authors: Michael P. Keane, Timothy Neal, Patrick Vu
35633.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在工具变量（IV）研究中，研究者经常评估多个候选工具变量，并选择性地报告第一阶段或第二阶段统计量最有利的设定。我们表明，这种形式的工具选择（“工具变量操纵”）会导致IV估计量相对于OLS估计量产生中位数偏误，从而削弱使用IV的合理性。当所有候选工具变量具有相同的真实强度时，中位数偏误随可用工具变量数量的增加而单调增加。
35633.abstract: In instrumental-variable (IV) studies, researchers often evaluate multiple candidate instruments and selectively report the specification with the most favorable first- or second-stage statistics. We show that this form of instrument selection (“instrument-hacking”) induces median bias in IV estimators toward the OLS estimand, undermining the rationale for using IV. When all candidate instruments have the same true strength, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. More generally, when candidate instruments differ in true strength, monotonicity need not hold because increasing the number of instruments can lead researchers to select genuinely stronger instruments. Nonetheless, in simulations calibrated to the empirical distribution of instrument strengths in the IV literature, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. Furthermore, it is substantial in magnitude, even when only a few instruments are available.

35691.title: Accounting for Credibility: Fiscal-Monetary Interactions and the Credibility of Central Bank Mandates
35691.zh_title: 为可信度记账：财政-货币互动与中央银行使命的可信度
35691.authors: Luigi Bocola, Gastón Chaumont, Alessandro Dovis, Rishabh Kirpalani
35691.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们沿袭Sargent和Wallace（1981）的传统，构建了一个财政与货币政策决定的模型。事前，政府有动机将货币政策委托给一个具有通胀目标使命的中央银行。然而，事后，政府面临撤销该使命以获取铸币税收入的诱惑。政府遵守其承诺的可能性取决于财政基本面的冲击和违背使命的成本。经济在货币政策遵守承诺的“货币主导”体制与财政当局干预货币政策的“财政主导”体制之间内生转换。这两种体制在通胀与债务-GDP比率联动性方面存在显著差异。
35691.abstract: We develop a model for fiscal and monetary policy determination in the tradition of Sargent and Wallace (1981). Ex-ante, the government has incentives to delegate monetary policy to a central bank with an inflation targeting mandate. Ex-post, however, the government faces temptations to revoke the mandate to generate seigniorage revenues. The likelihood that the government will adhere to its commitment depends on shocks to fiscal fundamentals and the costs of reneging on the mandate. The economy endogenously transitions between a “monetary-dominant” regime where monetary policy adheres to its commitment and a “fiscal-dominant” regime where the fiscal authority interferes with monetary policy. These two regimes sharply differ in their implications for the comovement of inflation and debt-to-GDP ratios. We use the model as a measurement device to interpret the fiscal and monetary history in Colombia, Chile, and the U.S.

35690.title: Inefficiencies in Local Infrastructure: Evidence from Drinking Water in California
35690.zh_title: 地方基础设施的低效率：来自加利福尼亚州饮用水的证据
35690.authors: Pierre Bodere, Giulia Brancaccio, Karam Kang
35690.zh_abstract_excerpt: 地方民选官员负责监管关键基础设施，但往往面临有限的选举问责。本文研究了这种情况如何扭曲加州饮用水系统的投资。我们记录了污染对政治环境变化的反应，从而激发了一个公共投资的动态模型。我们直接衡量投资带来的福利回报，将投资有效性和成本的事件研究估计与从住房选择中恢复的居民清洁用水估值相结合。投资选择识别了政策制定者对这些回报的响应程度。
35690.abstract: Local elected officials oversee critical infrastructure, often with limited electoral accountability. This paper studies how this distorts investment across California drinking-water systems. We document that pollution responds to shifts in the political environment, motivating a dynamic model of public investment. We measure welfare returns to investment directly, combining event-study estimates of investment effectiveness and costs with those of residents’ clean-water valuations, recovered from housing choices. Investment choices identify policymakers’ responsiveness to those returns. Weak accountability diverts investment from high-return systems and conventional policies imperfectly offset these distortions: subsidy takeup is misaligned with returns, while uniform mandates induce welfare losses.

35689.title: Artificial Intelligence and Political Advice
35689.zh_abstract_excerpt: 人工智能越来越多地被用于提供政治建议。我们研究了一种人工智能，它更了解与收益相关的状态，并且既关心准确性，也关心其所建议个体的感知福利。因此，该人工智能有动机将建议偏向于个体愿意相信的内容，从而改变其信息传递的政治内容和信息量。精明的个体会预见到这种扭曲，并过滤掉其可预测的政治成分，但仍然会学到更少，因为人工智能使其信息传递对状态的响应性降低。
35689.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used for political advice. We study an AI that is better informed about a payoff-relevant state and cares both about accuracy and about the perceived welfare of the individual it advises. The AI then has an incentive to tilt advice toward what the individual would like to believe, altering both the political content and the informativeness of its messages. Sophisticated individuals anticipate this distortion and filter out its predictable political component, yet still learn less because the AI makes its messages less responsive to the state. Individuals who underestimate the incentive instead mistake political accommodation for information, allowing political preferences to distort factual beliefs and generate polarization and radicalization. The model also shows that better-informed individuals receive more informative and less politically tilted advice, while greater sophistication can improve interpretation yet worsen communication itself. Contrary to the familiar echo-chamber intuition, political distortion is mitigated when political preferences and prior beliefs coincide and is most consequential when they diverge. We show how independently varying individuals’ stated preferences and prior beliefs can recover the AI’s responsiveness to the state even when the underlying state cannot be manipulated.
35689.zh_abstract: 人工智能越来越多地被用于提供政治建议。我们研究了一种人工智能，它更了解与收益相关的状态，并且既关心准确性，也关心其所建议个体的感知福利。因此，该人工智能有动机将建议偏向于个体愿意相信的内容，从而改变其信息传递的政治内容和信息量。精明的个体会预见到这种扭曲，并过滤掉其可预测的政治成分，但仍然会学到更少，因为人工智能使其信息传递对状态的响应性降低。低估这种激励的个体反而会将政治迎合误认为信息，从而使政治偏好扭曲事实信念，并产生两极分化和激进化。该模型还表明，信息更灵通的个体会收到更具信息量且政治倾向更少的建议，而更高的精明程度可以改善解读，但可能恶化沟通本身。与熟悉的回音室直觉相反，当政治偏好与先验信念一致时，政治扭曲会减轻，而当它们分歧时，政治扭曲最为严重。我们展示了如何独立改变个体陈述的偏好和先验信念，即使潜在状态无法被操纵，也能恢复人工智能对状态的响应性。

35688.title: Designing AI-Augmented Peer Review
35688.zh_title: 设计人工智能增强的同行评审
35688.zh_abstract_excerpt: 人工智能生成的稿件评估可以提高同行评审的质量，但与评审人分享这些评估可能会减少编辑所掌握的关于稿件的信息。人工同行评审之所以有价值，是因为评审人增加了人工智能评估所揭示的信息。当两位评审人看到相同的评估并犯下类似的错误时，他们可能会重复彼此的错误，巧合地调查相关领域，并共享相同的盲点。如果人工智能评估在评审人调查稿件时提高了他们的工作质量，那么只将报告提供给一位评审人可以更好地结合人工智能辅助与独立的人工调查。
35688.abstract: AI-generated assessments of manuscripts could improve the quality of peer review, but sharing them with reviewers might decrease the information that editors possess about the manuscript. Human peer reviews add value because reviewers add what the AI assessment reveals. When both reviewers see the same assessment and make similar errors, they can replicate each other’s mistakes, coincidentally investigate related areas, and share the same blind spots. If AI assessment improves the quality of reviewers’ work while they investigate the manuscript, giving the report to only one reviewer can better combine AI assistance with independent, human investigation. If some reviewers already use AI-generated assessments on their own, changing the journal policy to allow sharing the assessment can improve peer review if the change takes some of the burden of investigation off private tools that make similar errors, though giving the assessment to only one reviewer may still outperform giving it to both or neither. Even a report delivered after the reviews are submitted can still shift what reviewers investigate if they know in advance which issues it will check. Journal policy will depend on the AI’s effects on reviewer effort and the questions they investigate, whether reviewers are willing and able to comply with the policy, the monitoring costs, and the journal’s ability to protect the confidentiality of reviewer identities and emails. Journals can evaluate competing policies without knowing the true quality of the manuscripts they review by randomly varying who receives the assessment and then comparing reviewer disagreement across different levels of report sharing.

35687.title: The Safe-Debt Laffer Curve
35687.zh_abstract_excerpt: 即使主权国家仍然有偿付能力，安全公共债务也可能成为总需求的拖累。其安全性需要展期支持、做市和资产负债表能力。随着这些资源变得稀缺，生产安全国债索取权的边际成本上升。由此产生的财政调整减少了总支出，并最终可能超过增加安全资产供给的扩张效应。债务对总需求的稳态贡献随后达到峰值，均衡安全利率在同一债务存量处达到最大值。超过这一点，进一步发行会降低总需求和安全利率，即使债务仍然是安全的。
35687.abstract: Safe public debt can become a drag on aggregate demand even while the sovereign remains solvent. Its safety requires rollover support, market-making, and balance-sheet capacity. As these resources become scarce, the marginal cost of producing safe Treasury claims rises. The resulting fiscal adjustment reduces aggregate expenditure and can eventually outweigh the expansionary effect of increasing the supply of safe assets. Debt’s stationary contribution to aggregate demand then peaks, and the equilibrium safe rate reaches its maximum at the same debt stock. Beyond this point, further issuance lowers aggregate demand and the safe rate even though the debt remains safe. Empirically, I combine cash- Treasury and real-duration premia with estimates of how additional private supply reprices the outstanding Treasury stock. Over the past decade, the benchmark marginal cost more than doubled, rising from about 80 basis points in 2015Q1 to 187 basis points in 2026Q1. Using a 330-basis-point benchmark for the rate-equivalent wealth benefit, the safe-debt margin—the difference between this benefit and marginal cost—fell from about 250 to 143 basis points. At the CBO’s 2026 borrowing pace, the remaining safe-debt margin shrinks by about 18 basis points in one year, with further erosion accelerating as debt rises relative to financial capacity.

35686.title: Legislating Longevity: State Public Health Laws and Mortality in the Early Twentieth Century
35686.zh_title: 立法延长寿命：二十世纪初的州公共卫生法与死亡率
35686.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在二十世纪，各州立法机构颁布了大量公共卫生法律，其中大多数可能对死亡率的影响微乎其微。利用所有州级公共卫生法律和法规的数据，我检验了这些法律加在一起是否导致了死亡率的显著下降。为了解决内生性问题，我使用立法日历作为公共卫生立法的工具变量。OLS和IV估计都表明，公共卫生法律降低了死亡率，而其他法律和公共卫生法律的废除则没有。立法机构在减少水传播和排水相关疾病死亡方面最为有效，对空气传播传染病的效果减半，对非传染性疾病的效果仅为五分之一。
35686.abstract: State legislatures enacted numerous public-health laws during the twentieth century, most of which likely had negligible effects on mortality. Using data on the universe of state-level public-health laws and regulations, I test whether these laws, taken together, account for a meaningful decline in mortality. To address endogeneity, I instrument for public-health legislation using the legislative calendar. Both OLS and IV estimates indicate that public-health laws reduced mortality, whereas other laws and repeals of public-health laws did not. Legislatures were most effective at reducing deaths from waterborne and drainage-related diseases, half as effective for airborne communicable diseases, and one-fifth as effective for noncommunicable diseases. I use text analysis to classify the laws into twenty topics and find that laws targeting particular causes of death produced larger mortality declines for those causes. The universe of public-health laws can account for approximately two-thirds of the mortality decline during the study period.
35686.zh_abstract: 在二十世纪，各州立法机构颁布了大量公共卫生法律，其中大多数可能对死亡率的影响微乎其微。利用所有州级公共卫生法律和法规的数据，我检验了这些法律加在一起是否导致了死亡率的显著下降。为了解决内生性问题，我使用立法日历作为公共卫生立法的工具变量。OLS和IV估计都表明，公共卫生法律降低了死亡率，而其他法律和公共卫生法律的废除则没有。立法机构在减少水传播和排水相关疾病死亡方面最为有效，对空气传播传染病的效果减半，对非传染性疾病的效果仅为五分之一。我使用文本分析将法律分为二十个主题，并发现针对特定死因的法律对这些死因产生了更大的死亡率下降。在研究期间，所有公共卫生法律可以解释大约三分之二的死亡率下降。

35685.title: A Deep Case for Shallow Integration

35685.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了一个具有跨国货币性外部性和非货币性外部性的一般环境中的国际合作问题。我们推导出两个主要定理，每个定理都表明市场准入承诺（一种浅层一体化形式）足以实施全球有效的政策。当所有跨境外部性都是货币性时，第一个定理为Bagwell和Staiger的一系列结果提供了新的统一视角。当某些跨境外部性是非货币性时，第二个定理表明，适当扩展的市场准入承诺仍然能够维持全球效率。
35685.abstract: We study international cooperation in a general environment with pecuniary and non-pecuniary externalities across countries. We derive two main theorems, each demonstrating that market-access commitments, a form of shallow integration, are sufficient to implement globally efficient policies. When all cross-border externalities are pecuniary, the first theorem provides a new and unifying perspective on a series of results by Bagwell and Staiger. When some cross-border externalities are non-pecuniary, the second theorem shows that market-access commitments, properly extended, still sustain global efficiency. These extended market-access commitments reinterpret cross-border externalities as additional goods that are traded and priced at their social values. We discuss the implications for international cooperation on climate change and geopolitics.

35684.title: Canaries in the Gold Mine: Early Productivity Gains from Artificial Intelligence Creating Organization Capital

35684.authors: Tania Babina, Alex X. He, Renhao Jiang
35684.zh_abstract_excerpt: 利用基于AI技能就业的新的企业层面AI投资衡量指标——涵盖从机器学习到生成式和代理式AI——我们表明，近年来AI投资与生产率增长相关，但在过去十年中并非如此。我们将生产率收益追溯到AI帮助创造的组织资本的积累：通过干中学获得的持久的企业特定知识，这些知识能够实现更高效的生产。我们基于工人的职位描述构建了一个新颖的组织资本衡量指标，并记录了生产率收益是由构建组织资本的AI技能工作岗位驱动的。

We trace the productivity gains to the accumulation of organization capital that AI helps create: durable firm-specific knowledge acquired through learning-by-doing that enables more efficient production. We build a novel measure of organization capital based on workers’ job descriptions and document that productivity gains are driven by AI-skilled jobs that build organization capital. Overall, our findings suggest that AI investment generates productivity growth by creating organization capital.

35683.title: Can Private Markets Fill the Gap? Graduate Student Lending After the Elimination of GradPLUS
35683.zh_title: 私人市场能否填补缺口？GradPLUS取消后的研究生贷款
35683.zh_abstract_excerpt: 《一项大而美的法案》（OBBBA，公法119-21）自2026年7月1日起取消了针对新借款人的联邦GradPLUS贷款计划，用每年20,500美元（11个专业领域为50,000美元）的年度限额和新的总限额取代了近二十年无上限的联邦研究生贷款。由此产生的融资缺口——每年约80亿美元，涉及约370,000名受影响的借款人——引发了私人资本是否会以及如何替代被取代的联邦贷款的问题。本文分析了这一转变的经济学。
35683.abstract: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA, P.L. 119-21) eliminates the federal GradPLUS loan program for new borrowers effective July 1, 2026, replacing nearly two decades of uncapped federal graduate lending with annual limits of $20,500 ($50,000 for eleven professional fields) and new aggregate caps. The resulting financing gap — approximately $8 billion annually across roughly 370,000 affected borrowers — raises the question of whether and how private capital will substitute for displaced federal lending. This paper analyzes the economics of that transition. Before GradPLUS, private lenders filled the gap between federal Stafford limits and graduate program costs, with nonfederal graduate originations reaching $5.3 billion (constant 2024 dollars) by 2005–06. After GradPLUS extended federal borrowing to the full cost of attendance in 2006, private lending collapsed — falling more than 70 percent within a few years and never recovering. The federal program provided not only credit but, through income-driven repayment and Public Service Loan Forgiveness, insurance against earnings risk that no private product could replicate. The same features that crowded out private lending generated compounding distortions: borrowing untethered to repayment capacity, upward pressure on tuition, and a reversal from projected federal surpluses to losses exceeding thirty cents per GradPLUS dollar lent. Linking institution-by-field federal borrowing data to institution-by-field earnings outcomes, I examine the relationship between historical borrowing above the new OBBBA caps and post-completion earnings across programs. I find substantial variation in the extent to which different degree programs would likely support above-cap borrowing from private lenders or other sources. In fields such as law and MBA, earnings rise steeply with borrowing exposure, providing a basis for program-level risk pricing; in fields such as social work, counseling psychology, and physical therapy, the earnings-to-borrowing gradient is essentially flat. I also examine features of the private capital market and institutional responses shaping the transition — including capital constraints on scaling private lending, legal barriers to using program-level outcomes data in underwriting, and the emerging role of institutions as intermediaries between lenders and students.
35683.zh_abstract: 《一项大而美的法案》（OBBBA，公法119-21）自2026年7月1日起取消了针对新借款人的联邦GradPLUS贷款计划，用每年20,500美元（11个专业领域为50,000美元）的年度限额和新的总限额取代了近二十年无上限的联邦研究生贷款。由此产生的融资缺口——每年约80亿美元，涉及约370,000名受影响的借款人——引发了私人资本是否会以及如何替代被取代的联邦贷款的问题。本文分析了这一转变的经济学。在GradPLUS之前，私人贷款机构填补了联邦Stafford贷款限额与研究生项目成本之间的缺口，到2005-06年，非联邦研究生贷款发放额达到53亿美元（按2024年不变美元计算）。2006年GradPLUS将联邦借款扩展到全部就读成本后，私人贷款崩溃——几年内下降超过70%，且从未恢复。联邦计划不仅提供信贷，还通过收入驱动还款和公共服务贷款宽恕提供了任何私人产品都无法复制的收入风险保险。正是这些排挤私人贷款的特征产生了复合扭曲：借款与还款能力脱钩、学费上涨压力，以及从预期的联邦盈余逆转为每贷出1美元GradPLUS贷款损失超过30美分。将机构-领域层面的联邦借款数据与机构-领域层面的收入结果联系起来，我考察了各项目中高于新OBBBA上限的历史借款与毕业后收入之间的关系。我发现，不同学位项目在多大程度上可能支持从私人贷款机构或其他来源进行高于上限的借款方面存在显著差异。在法律和MBA等领域，收入随借款敞口急剧上升，为项目层面的风险定价提供了基础；在社会工作、咨询心理学和物理治疗等领域，收入与借款的斜率基本持平。我还考察了影响这一转变的私人资本市场特征和机构反应——包括扩大私人贷款规模的资本约束、在承保中使用项目层面结果数据的法律障碍，以及机构作为贷款人与学生之间中介的新兴角色。

35682.title: Pollution Pricing in Equilibrium: Production, Reallocation, and Aggregate Impacts
35682.zh_title: 均衡中的污染定价：生产、再配置与总体影响
35682.authors: R. Andrew Butters, Jackson Dorsey, Ivan Rudik
35682.zh_abstract_excerpt: 污染定价能在多大程度上减少总体排放，成本又是多少？我们开发了一个基于微观基础的企业生产和减排均衡模型，该模型可以利用标准的企业财务和排放数据进行估计，而无需直接观察减排努力。该模型捕捉了三个调整边际：短期投入替代、产出从高污染企业向清洁企业的再配置，以及长期清洁技术采用。将其应用于欧盟排放交易体系（EU-ETS）的前17年，我们发现投入替代是刚性的：企业无法在不削减产出的情况下在短期内减少排放。
35682.abstract: How much does pricing pollution cut aggregate emissions, and at what cost? We develop a microfounded equilibrium model of firm production and abatement that can be estimated from standard firm financial and emissions data, without observing abatement effort directly. The model captures three adjustment margins: short-run input substitution, reallocation of output from dirty to cleaner firms, and long-run clean technology adoption. Applying it to the first 17 years of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU-ETS), we find input substitution is rigid: firms cannot cut emissions in the short run without cutting output. Reallocation instead drives nearly all of the short-run aggregate emissions response, concentrated in sectors with heterogeneous emissions intensities, like power and cement, or with elastic demand, like refining. Clean technology adoption also responds causally to permit price shocks, reducing firms’ emissions intensity over the five years that follow. Doubling the permit price cuts aggregate emissions 23% in the short run and 31% in the longer run after induced clean technology adoption. In the short run, output falls by 4%, primarily because carbon costs pass from upstream polluting industries like electricity to downstream producers. In the long run, output falls just 2.5%, as clean technology adoption dampens these supply-chain impacts. Carbon pricing thus delivers substantial emissions reductions with moderate output effects, and much of the economic burden falls on downstream firms through higher upstream input costs.

35681.title: Spillover Effects of Transfer Programs
35681.zh_title: 转移支付项目的溢出效应
35681.authors: Travis Baseler, Jules Gazeaud, Erik Snowberg
35681.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们从关于现金和实物转移支付项目对非受益者溢出效应的实验中得出四个事实：（1）对消费和资产价值的平均溢出效应可以忽略不计；（2）在通过村内抽签随机排除在转移支付之外的家庭中，长期会出现负面的心理溢出效应；（3）这些溢出效应集中在消费贫困家庭中；（4）当转移支付受益者的选择基于资格标准时，这些溢出效应不会出现。这些发现与家庭偏好反对村内随机分配转移支付的观点一致，并指出了集群层面随机设计相对于家庭层面设计的额外优势。
35681.abstract: We derive four facts from experiments on the spillover effects of cash and in-kind transfer programs onto non-recipients: (1) average spillovers on consumption and asset value are negligible; (2) negative psychological spillovers emerge in the longer term among households randomly excluded from transfers by within-village lotteries; (3) these spillovers are concentrated in consumption-poor households; and (4) they do not appear when the selection of transfer recipients is eligibility-based. These findings are consistent with household preferences against within-village randomization of transfers, and point to additional benefits of cluster-level randomized designs over household-level ones.

35680.title: The Anatomy and Evolution of Survey Error
35680.zh_title: 调查误差的解剖与演变
35680.authors: Bruce D. Meyer, Nikolas Mittag, Derek Wu, Anthony Tatarka, Patrick Langetieg
35680.zh_abstract_excerpt: 调查提供了社会科学中我们所知的大部分内容，并且通常是私人行为、态度和期望的唯一信息来源。文献的各个分支记录了四大类误差来源：调查覆盖、单位无应答、项目无应答和测量误差。然而，由于缺乏跨来源和跨时间的可比误差度量，误差来源的相对严重性难以评估，限制了调查生产者改进准确性和使用者解读调查统计数据的努力。我们通过在一个实证总调查误差（TSE）框架中分析和分解调查误差来统一分散的文献，首次在共同的偏差和绝对误差尺度上量化每个误差组成部分。
35680.abstract: Surveys provide much of what we know in social science and are often the only source of information on private behaviors, attitudes and expectations. Strands of the literature document four broad error sources: survey coverage, unit non-response, item non-response, and measurement error. Yet the absence of comparable error measures across sources and over time has left the relative severity of error sources difficult to assess, limiting efforts by survey producers to improve accuracy and users to interpret survey statistics. We unify the fragmented literature by analyzing and decomposing survey error in an empirical Total Survey Error (TSE) framework, quantifying for the first time every error component on a common scale of bias and absolute error. We apply our approach to comprehensively measure survey error in eighteen income and program receipt variables from the CPS ASEC – one of the oldest and most rigorously tested surveys, and the official source of income and poverty statistics in the U.S. – using linked administrative records over more than two decades. For nearly half of the variables, bias exceeds 40 percent and eliminating all individual-level error would require changing more than 80 percent of the true total. Contrary to the conventional emphasis on non-response, we find that the dominant source of bias is measurement error among respondents who fail to report receipt (false negatives). The largest potential gains therefore come from improving the accuracy of respondent reporting rather than raising response rates. This underreporting also propagates into imputed values for non-respondents, which are drawn from (misreported) responses and are particularly noisy, with positive and negative errors that tend to offset in net terms. Moreover, net bias can be an incomplete guide to data quality, as we find that absolute error has tended to rise over time even when net bias is stable. Overall, our approach provides a new method for measuring and decomposing survey error, clarifying which sources of bias require user corrections and where survey design improvements could be most consequential.

35679.title: An Efficient Liquidity Savings Mechanism
35679.zh_title: 一种高效的流动性节约机制
35679.authors: Darrell Duffie, Srisht F. Singh, Chaojun Wang
35679.zh_abstract_excerpt: 流动性节约机制（LSMs）减少了银行处理支付所需的准备金余额数量。LSM可以缓解协调失灵问题，即银行因预期其他银行也会延迟支付而相互延迟支付。我们提供了一种最大化效率的新型LSM的设计和性质。
35679.abstract: Liquidity savings mechanisms (LSMs) reduce the quantity of reserve balances that banks need to process payments. An LSM can mitigate coordination failures in which banks delay their payments to each other because they expect that other banks will do the same. We provide the design and properties of a maximally efficient new form of LSM.

35677.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们在一项具有全国代表性的调查中衡量了工人如何在工作中使用生成式人工智能（genAI），该调查将genAI的采用与详细的职业和任务联系起来。我们的数据提供了首个任务层面的genAI采用指数，我们表明这些指数可以为genAI对劳动力市场影响的分析提供信息。暴露评分解释了职业和任务间采用差异的一部分，但远非全部。

35676.title: Firms as Electoral Monopsonies

35676.authors: Carlos Fernando Avenancio-León, Adelina Barbalau, Cyndi Hou, Alessio Piccolo
35676.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了主导雇主如何充当“选举买方垄断者”，利用地方劳动力市场力量来塑造政治偏好和选举结果。我们首先展示了原始调查证据，表明主要本地雇主的员工更有可能经历雇主的政治沟通，并报告其雇主影响他们的投票行为和职业期望。然后，我们开发了一个模型，其中主导雇主可以通过塑造选民对工资和就业如何取决于选举结果的期望来影响选民的偏好。我们区分了被动渠道（工人内化企业的经济利益）和主动渠道（主导雇主战略性地影响这些期望）。
35676.abstract: We study how dominant employers can act as *electoral monopsonies*, using local labor market power to shape political preferences and electoral outcomes. We first present original survey evidence showing that workers at major local employers are more likely to experience employer political communication and to report that their employers influence their voting behavior and career expectations. We then develop a model in which a dominant employer can affect voters’ preferences by shaping their expectations about how wages and employment depend on electoral outcomes. Under the active channel, labor market power translates into political power and can generate political failures by inducing voters to oppose policies they would otherwise support. The model also shows how electoral monopsonies can contribute to political polarization, constrain political platforms, and substitute for campaign spending. Using U.S. individual-level voting data and a shift-share design based on national industry concentration shocks and predetermined local employment shares, we show that greater electoral monopsony power increases Republican voter turnout. Counterfactual estimates imply that reducing electoral monopsony power could have narrowly changed the outcomes of the 2016 and 2024 presidential elections.

35675.title: The Distribution and Consequences of Natural Disasters: Evidence from U.S. Wildfire Victims

35675.authors: Patrick Baylis, Judson Boomhower, Jonathan M. Colmer, John L. Voorheis
35675.zh_abstract_excerpt: 自然灾害的经济负担取决于谁暴露于风险、谁遭受损失、这些损失如何改变个人经济轨迹，以及受灾社区在灾后如何演变。我们将来自100多起美国野火的财产级损失数据与行政税收和人口普查数据联系起来，以理解灾害损失与经济结果之间的个人层面关系。被烧毁地区的居民平均比美国人口更富有，但在这些野火边界内，房屋被烧毁的可能性与火灾前收入呈负相关。
35675.abstract: The economic burden of natural disasters is shaped by who is exposed, who experiences losses, how those losses alter individual economic trajectories, and how affected communities evolve in the aftermath. We do not detect income or employment effects for residents without direct property damage. Community recovery is slow and accompanied by changes in composition. Four years after a fire, half of destroyed addresses remain unoccupied and reoccupied addresses house residents with substantially higher incomes than before.

35673.authors: Drishan Banerjee, Galina Hale, Harrison Shieh
35673.zh_abstract_excerpt: 疫情后的通胀引发了人们对美国货币紧缩将重演1982年新兴经济体资本流动突然停止的担忧。然而，截至2026年，尚未出现全球衰退。我们确立了三个显著事实，用以区分1980年代与2020年代，除了向浮动汇率制的转变之外：货币政策有效性、财政空间和外部脆弱性。我们在一个带有财政空间约束的蒙代尔-弗莱明框架中对其进行了合理化解释，该框架预测财政空间在传导外币无风险利率上升方面发挥核心作用。跨国证据证实，财政空间塑造了紧缩后的经济表现。

35672.title: Explaining the Predictive Performance of Police in Cases of Domestic Abuse

35672.authors: Jeffrey Grogger, Andrew Jordan, Tom Kirchmaier
35672.zh_abstract_excerpt: 英格兰和威尔士的警方被要求预测家庭虐待案件中严重再犯的可能性，但除了一个有缺陷的问卷外，几乎没有其他支持。为了分析他们的决策，我们首先开发了处理审查问题的方法，该问题源于警官的预测可能改变她试图预测的结果。即使在调整审查之后，我们发现预测表现仍然很低，在某些情况下甚至低于偶然预期的水平。接下来，我们探究他们的预测是否代表错误，并提供了几种类型的佐证证据。
35672.abstract: Police in England and Wales are asked to predict the likelihood of serious recidivism in domestic abuse cases, with little support beyond a flawed questionnaire. To analyze their decisions, we first develop methods to deal with a censoring problem that arises because the officer’s prediction may change the outcome she was attempting to predict. Even after adjusting for censoring, we find predictive performance to be low, even lower in some cases than what one would expect by chance. We next ask whether their predictions represent mistakes, and provide several types of confirmatory evidence. We ask how officers formulate their predictions, and we find evidence consistent with representativeness bias, overreaction, and categorization and selective attention. We find that higher-skill officers use information not captured by the questionnaire to improve their predictions, whereas lower-skill officers use such information in ways that reduce accuracy.

35671.zh_abstract_excerpt: 像公文式（Kumon）和思而文（Sylvan）这样的私人辅导连锁机构在近几十年迅速扩张。结合商业地点、家庭支出和学区考试成绩的数据，我们研究了谁在使用这些中心以及它们如何影响学业技能。近一半的辅导使用者来自收入最高的十分位，亚裔和白人家庭购买辅导的可能性分别是黑人和西班牙裔家庭的五倍和两倍。一个交错的双重差分设计显示，一个学区第一家连锁中心的开设使全区数学和阅读成绩提高了0.02-0.03个标准差，其成本远低于通常产生类似收益的公共支出。

These private investments help their users, deepen educational inequality, and shape outcomes by which state accountability systems and families judge schools.

35669.authors: Kai Arvai, Nuno Coimbra, Marco Pinchetti
35669.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究了在经济和地缘政治冲击塑造的环境中，国际投资者在黄金和主权债券之间投资组合选择的决定因素。我们开发了一个内生投资组合选择模型，其中储备安全性具有政治维度——由主导储备货币国发行的主权债券流动性更强，但面临发行者制裁权力的风险，而黄金提供制裁保护，但流动性较低。我们的模型表明，在高制裁风险时期，美国的便利收益率下降，因为安全资产需求沿地缘政治路线分裂。实证上，地缘政治风险升高时期与黄金价格和10年期国债收益率上升同时发生。
35669.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of international investors’ portfolio choices between gold and sovereign bonds in an environment shaped by economic and geopolitical shocks. We develop an endogenous portfolio choice model where reserve safety has a political dimension — sovereign bonds issued by the dominant reserve country are more liquid but exposed to the issuer’s sanctions authority, while gold offers sanctions protection at the cost of lower liquidity. Our model implies that US convenience yields fall during periods of high sanction risk, as safe-asset demand fragments along geopolitical lines. In such periods, the average composition of official reserves shifts toward gold, with countries less aligned with the US increasing their holdings to a greater extent.

35668.zh_abstract_excerpt: 欧元区的失业率显著高于美国，且波动性更大。我们探究跨国劳动力流动性的缺乏在多大程度上可以解释欧洲的失业动态。我们的分析模型包含了名义工资刚性下行和内生移民决策。企业在经济收缩期间无法自由调整工资，从而在商业周期中产生不对称的失业分布。该模型根据典型欧元区国家的失业和净移民动态进行了校准。将劳动力流动性提高到美国观察到的水平，并保持所有其他参数不变，将使欧元区失业率的波动性降低28%，并使超过1,000,000名失业者重返劳动力队伍。

35667.authors: Qing Liu, Zanhui Liu, Vivian Zhanwei Yue
35667.zh_abstract_excerpt: 官方贷款规模大、优先级高且具有逆周期性，在主权重陷私人债务违约后仍会继续。我们探究为何主权融资在债权人之间表现出这种分工。在一个风险厌恶的主权国家私下分配进口投入品的生产经济中，双方承诺均有限，且监督产生噪声信号，约束最优配置由可违约的私人债务、优先级的不可违约多边债务以及其减免与信号挂钩的优惠双边债务分散化实现。生产仍然扭曲，但主权国家永远不会被排除在外：官方贷款是受监督的流动性提供。校准重现了顺周期的私人债务和逆周期的官方债务。

35666.title: Making Everyone’s Preferences Count: A Prospect Theory Approach to Valuing Health Improvements

35666.authors: Karen Mulligan, Drishti Baid, Jason N. Doctor, Darius N. Lakdawalla
35666.zh_abstract_excerpt: 卫生技术评估机构和政策制定者一直在争论应将谁的偏好——普通健康人群还是患者群体——纳入传统的成本效果分析。这一争论源于健康个体和患者往往对相同的健康状态赋予不同的价值，且成本效果分析无法解释适应性，因而会低估患有慢性疾病或残疾个体的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。前景理论（PT）提供了一个允许适应性的框架，因为它假设个体是相对于参考点来评估结果的。
35666.abstract: Health technology assessment bodies and policymakers have grappled with the issue of whose preferences – the general healthy population or the patient population – should be incorporated into traditional cost-effectiveness analysis. This debate arises because healthy individuals and patients often value the same health state differently, and cost-effectiveness will undervalue health-related quality of life (HRQoL) for individuals with chronic illness or disability because it cannot account for adaptation. Prospect theory (PT) provides a framework that permits adaptation since it assumes individuals evaluate outcomes relative to a reference point. We estimate utility over HRQoL in a PT framework in a nationally representative U.S. population and compare directly with utility estimates in an EU framework from the same population. Consistent with previous studies in the monetary and health domains, we find evidence of probability weighting bias and loss aversion over health. Using the PT utility estimates, we demonstrate how PT can be incorporated into healthcare value assessment and present the resulting implications for medical decision making.

35665.zh_title: 私人市场的民主化：均衡预测
35665.authors: Lubos Pastor, Robert F. Stambaugh, Lucian A. Taylor
35665.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了向散户投资者开放私人市场对投资者和企业的影响。通过校准一个基于生产的资产定价模型，我们发现民主化提高了散户投资者的福利，但幅度甚微。即使散户投资者没有面临额外成本或相对于机构投资者的其他劣势，他们从民主化中获益也很少。私人市场规模太小，以至于改善风险分担的作用不大。无论私人市场散户投资是否有成本，民主化都大幅重塑了私营企业的所有权，并实质性降低了其资本成本，促使它们增长。

35664.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用新数字化的美国国税局纳税申报数据，记录了1969年至2019年间美国收入风险的增加，并区分了永久性风险与暂时性风险。自1970年代以来，永久性收入风险在整个收入分布中均有所增加，但在高收入者中增幅最为显著，前5%人群的永久性收入风险上升了近70%。我们表明，即使在顶级收入者中，大的负面收入冲击也能强烈预测财务困境，且更高的收入风险与更高的储蓄相关。在一个定量生命周期模型中，集中在顶端的收入风险上升使无风险利率降低了0.

35663.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
35663.zh_title: CentaurBench：基准测试LLM在增强与自动化现实工作任务方面的能力
35663.authors: Pattaraphon Kenny Wongchamcharoen, Kris Gulati, Min Min Fong, Abhishek Nagaraj
35663.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大多数LLM基准测试根据模型自动化工作任务的能力对其进行排名。然而，在实践中，模型通常被用来辅助其他（人类或LLM）智能体。因此，驱动模型选择的不仅是哪个模型能产生最佳输出，而是哪个模型最能改进另一个（较弱的）智能体的工作。我们引入了一个统一框架，用于评估模型自动化和增强另一个智能体表现的能力。在七个具有经济学基础的真实世界任务中，一个辅助模型为标准化低能力工作者模型编写辅助文本，后者负责生成交付物。在自动化模式下，辅助模型直接生成输出。
35663.abstract: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks, an assistant model writes assistance text for a standardized lower-capacity worker model, which produces the deliverable. In automation mode, the assistant produces the output directly. Outputs are scored through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel with task-specific rubrics, replicated across ten runs. Rankings across the two regimes are only modestly correlated, and the automation winner loses augmentation on five of seven tasks. Assistance is not reliably positive. The unaided worker outranks every assisted condition on three tasks, and only one model's guidance beats no guidance on average. These results suggest that automation ability is an incomplete proxy for assistance quality, motivating benchmarks that evaluate models according to the roles they play in human-AI and multi-agent systems.

35662.zh_abstract_excerpt: 纳瓦霍族采纳了最全面的改善饮食的财政政策之一；2014-15年的《健康迪纳民族法案》（HDNA）包含两部分：1）对健康食品和饮料免征销售税；2）对不健康食品和饮料增税。两者共同在健康与不健康食品之间形成了7-8%的价格差。我们估计了双重差分模型和事件研究，以评估HDNA对出生证明数据中记录的新生儿和母亲与饮食及体重相关的多种健康状况的影响。我们没有发现HDNA改善这些结果的证据；

35661.title: Tariff-Dispersion Shocks: The Mean is the Variance
35661.zh_title: 关税离散度冲击：均值即方差
35661.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究了美国进口关税税率在HTS 6位码商品层面的均值和离散度随时间的联合行为，以及驱动这两个矩的冲击的宏观经济后果。我们记录了进口关税的横截面均值和横截面离散度随时间紧密同步变动。使用状态空间模型，我们发现两者主要由共同冲击驱动，而均值特定和离散度特定的关税冲击作用可忽略不计。因此，实际上不存在独立的均值关税冲击或关税离散度冲击；只有均值-离散度关税冲击。这些共同冲击对进口和贸易余额的变动有相当大的解释力，但对产出的变动解释力很小。
35661.abstract: This paper studies the joint behavior over time of the mean and dispersion of U.S. import tariff rates across goods at the HTS 6-digit level, as well as the macroeconomic consequences of the shocks that drive these two moments. We document that the cross-sectional mean and the cross-sectional dispersion of import tariffs move closely together over time. Using a state-space model, we find that both are driven primarily by common shocks, while mean- and dispersion-specific tariff shocks play a negligible role. Thus, effectively, there are no separate mean-tariff shocks or tariff-dispersion shocks; there are only mean-dispersion tariff shocks. These common shocks account for a sizable share of movements in imports and the trade balance but only a small fraction of movements in output. A positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shock reduces the import-to-output ratio and improves the trade-balance-to-output ratio; a positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shock also reduces the import-to-output ratio but has a muted effect on the trade-balance-to-output ratio. Positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shocks are expansionary, whereas positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shocks are contractionary in the short run and expansionary in the medium run.
35661.zh_abstract: 本文研究了美国进口关税税率在HTS 6位码商品层面的均值和离散度随时间的联合行为，以及驱动这两个矩的冲击的宏观经济后果。我们记录了进口关税的横截面均值和横截面离散度随时间紧密同步变动。使用状态空间模型，我们发现两者主要由共同冲击驱动，而均值特定和离散度特定的关税冲击作用可忽略不计。因此，实际上不存在独立的均值关税冲击或关税离散度冲击；只有均值-离散度关税冲击。这些共同冲击对进口和贸易余额的变动有相当大的解释力，但对产出的变动解释力很小。正向的暂时性均值-离散度关税冲击降低了进口与产出之比，并改善了贸易余额与产出之比；正向的永久性均值-离散度关税冲击也降低了进口与产出之比，但对贸易余额与产出之比的影响较弱。正向的暂时性均值-离散度关税冲击是扩张性的，而正向的永久性均值-离散度关税冲击在短期内是收缩性的，在中期内是扩张性的。

35660.title: Fear as a Campaign Tool: Evidence from the 2014 U.S. Ebola Scare
35660.zh_title: 恐惧作为竞选工具：来自2014年美国埃博拉恐慌的证据
35660.authors: Filipe R. Campante, Emilio Depetris-Chauvin, Ruben Durante
35660.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用2014年埃博拉恐慌作为自然实验，研究强调感知威胁的政治沟通的供给。通过分析美国众议院和参议院候选人的推特帖子和国会通讯，我们发现共和党人增加了与埃博拉相关的沟通，强调负面情绪并将其与移民问题联系起来。这种反应在共和党安全席位中最为强烈，与基本盘信号传递一致。供给方是主动的，而非被动的：共和党的反应并不随确诊病例的邻近程度而变化，尽管选民焦虑集中；政治家的推文预测了公众的埃博拉活动，但反之不然；
35660.abstract: We study the supply of political communication highlighting perceived threats, using the 2014 Ebola scare as a natural experiment. Analyzing Twitter posts and congressional newsletters from US House and Senate candidates, we find Republicans increased Ebola-related communication, emphasizing negative sentiment and links to immigration. This response was strongest in safe Republican seats, consistent with base signaling. The supply side was active, not reactive: the Republican response did not vary with proximity to diagnosed cases despite concentrated voter anxiety, politician tweets predicted public Ebola activity but not vice-versa, and more intensive messaging correlated with better electoral outcomes, controlling for local conditions.
